modules.summary: The library every program sees without importing it: numbers, arrays, sorting, heaps, strings, parsing, printing and random numbers.

symbols.name: INF
symbols.description: Constant for positive infinity as a real value, computed by overflowing a large literal.

symbols.name: EULER
symbols.description: Constant for Euler's number e as a real value.

symbols.name: popcount
symbols.description: Returns the number of set bits in an unsigned integer.

symbols.name: clz
symbols.description: Returns the number of leading zero bits in an unsigned integer.

symbols.name: ctz
symbols.description: Returns the number of trailing zero bits in an unsigned integer.

symbols.name: pow
symbols.description: Returns x raised to the power y for real values.

symbols.name: pow
symbols.description: Returns x raised to the power y for f32 values.

symbols.name: std_fabs
symbols.description: Thin binding to the C fabs function returning the absolute value of a real.

symbols.name: std_fabsf
symbols.description: Thin binding to the C fabsf function returning the absolute value of an f32.

symbols.name: std_floor
symbols.description: Thin binding to the C floor function, wrapped by ifloor.

symbols.name: std_ceil
symbols.description: Thin binding to the C ceil function, wrapped by iceil.

symbols.name: std_round
symbols.description: Thin binding to the C round function returning a real rounded to the nearest integer.

symbols.name: std_bits
symbols.description: Thin binding returning the raw 64-bit IEEE pattern of a real, used by hashing.

symbols.name: float_dec
symbols.description: Thin binding that returns decimal digits of a real and writes the exponent through e.

symbols.name: pyout
symbols.description: Binds the C runtime routine that writes a byte string to output for Python-dialect printing.

symbols.name: store_u64le
symbols.signature: store_u64le(s byte[:], at int, v uint)
symbols.description: Thin binding that stores a 64-bit unsigned value into a byte slice at an offset in little-endian order.

symbols.name: load_u64le
symbols.signature: load_u64le(s const byte[:], at int) uint
symbols.description: Thin binding that loads a 64-bit unsigned value from a byte slice at an offset in little-endian order.

symbols.name: std_from_bits
symbols.description: Thin binding that builds a real from a raw 64-bit IEEE bit pattern.

symbols.name: std_mulhi
symbols.description: Multiplies two unsigned integers and returns the high 64 bits of the product; a thin C binding for internal use.

symbols.name: std_vk_cpu
symbols.description: Returns the CPU capability flag, 1 when the vectorized string routines are usable; a thin C binding behind hxk.

symbols.name: std_ptr
symbols.description: Returns the raw address of a byte slice as an unsigned integer for use with low-level C bindings.

symbols.name: std_ld8
symbols.description: Loads an unsigned 64-bit value from the raw memory address p.

symbols.name: std_st8
symbols.description: Stores the unsigned 64-bit value v at the raw memory address p.

symbols.name: std_st1
symbols.description: Stores the low byte of integer v at the raw memory address p.

symbols.name: std_zdec
symbols.description: Decodes the unsigned value b into digits and writes the decimal exponent through e; a thin C binding.

symbols.name: std_vk_span
symbols.description: Scans n bytes starting at address p with vector code and returns how many bytes to skip; used by each_word.

symbols.name: std_vk_hexenc
symbols.signature: std_vk_hexenc(d uint, s uint, n int)
symbols.description: Encodes n bytes at address s as hexadecimal text written to address d; a thin C binding.

symbols.name: std_vk_hexdec
symbols.signature: std_vk_hexdec(d uint, s uint, n int) int
symbols.description: Decodes n hexadecimal characters at address s into bytes at address d and returns a status result; a thin C binding.

symbols.name: min
symbols.description: Returns the smaller of two values.

symbols.name: max
symbols.description: Returns the larger of two values.

symbols.name: min

symbols.description: Returns the smallest of three values.

symbols.name: max
symbols.signature: max<T>(a T, b T, c T) T
symbols.description: Returns the largest of three values.

symbols.name: min
symbols.signature: min<T>(a T, b T, c T, d T) T
symbols.description: Returns the smallest of four values.

symbols.name: max
symbols.signature: max<T>(a T, b T, c T, d T) T
symbols.description: Returns the largest of four values.

symbols.name: clamp
symbols.signature: clamp<T>(x T, lo T, hi T) T
symbols.description: Returns x limited to the range from lo to hi, keeping the sign of negative zero.

symbols.name: abs
symbols.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

symbols.name: sign
symbols.description: Returns -1, 0 or 1 according to the sign of a generic value.

symbols.name: sign
symbols.description: Returns -1.0, 1.0 or x itself when zero, giving the sign of a real.

symbols.name: sign
symbols.description: Returns -1.0, 1.0 or x itself when zero, giving the sign of an f32.

symbols.name: lerp
symbols.signature: lerp(a real, b real, t real) real
symbols.description: Returns the linear interpolation between a and b at parameter t for reals.

symbols.name: lerp
symbols.signature: lerp(a f32, b f32, t f32) f32
symbols.description: Returns the linear interpolation between a and b at parameter t for f32 values.

symbols.name: swap
symbols.description: Swaps the values of two variables passed by reference.

symbols.name: rem
symbols.description: Returns the remainder of a divided by b, taking the sign of a.

symbols.name: div_euclid
symbols.description: Returns the quotient of a and b rounded so the remainder is never negative.

symbols.name: next_pow2
symbols.description: Returns the smallest power of two that is at least x, or 1 for x of 1 or less.

symbols.name: pow
symbols.description: Returns the integer b raised to the non-negative power e.

symbols.name: pow
symbols.signature: pow(b int, e int, m int) int
symbols.description: Returns the integer b raised to the power e modulo m using repeated squaring.

symbols.name: isqrt
symbols.description: Returns the floor of the square root of n, for n of zero or more.

symbols.name: gcd
symbols.description: Returns the greatest common divisor of two integers, always non-negative.

symbols.name: lcm
symbols.description: Returns the least common multiple of two integers, or 0 if either is zero.

symbols.name: factorial
symbols.description: Returns the factorial of n as an integer.

symbols.name: perm
symbols.description: Returns the number of ordered selections of k items from n, or 0 if k is out of range.

symbols.name: comb
symbols.description: Returns the number of unordered selections of k items from n, or 0 if k is out of range.

symbols.name: ifloor
symbols.description: Returns the largest integer not greater than a real value.

symbols.name: iceil
symbols.description: Returns the smallest integer not less than a real value.

symbols.name: hash_mix
symbols.description: Returns a well-mixed 64-bit hash of an unsigned value so every input bit affects every output bit.

symbols.name: hash_combine
symbols.description: Returns a new hash combining a running seed with another hash value.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of an int.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of an unsigned integer.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of an i32.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of a u32.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of an i16.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of a u16.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of an i8.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of a byte.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of a bool.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of a real, treating 0.0 and -0.0 the same.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of an f32.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a 64-bit hash of a byte string, covering all bytes and the length.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.description: Returns a hash of a two-element tuple by combining the hashes of its fields.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.signature: hash<A, B, C>(t tuple3<A, B, C>) uint
symbols.description: Returns a hash of a three-element tuple by combining the hashes of its fields.

symbols.name: hash
symbols.signature: hash<A, B, C, D>(t tuple4<A, B, C, D>) uint
symbols.description: Returns a hash of a four-element tuple by combining the hashes of its fields.

symbols.name: contains
symbols.description: Returns true if the slice contains an element equal to v.

symbols.name: contains
symbols.description: Returns true if the byte string contains sub as a contiguous run.

symbols.name: find
symbols.description: Returns the position of the first element equal to v, or -1 if absent.

symbols.name: find
symbols.description: Returns the position of the first run equal to sub, or -1 if absent.

symbols.name: find
symbols.signature: find(s byte[:], t byte[:], start int) int
symbols.description: Returns the position of the first occurrence of t in s at or after start, or -1.

symbols.name: find
symbols.description: Returns the first element the block accepts, or null if none does.

symbols.name: rfind
symbols.description: Returns the position of the last run equal to sub, or -1 if absent.

symbols.name: index
symbols.description: Returns the position of the first element equal to v, or -1 if absent.

symbols.name: index
symbols.description: Returns the position of the first run equal to sub, or -1 if absent.

symbols.name: position
symbols.description: Returns the position of the first element equal to v, or -1 if absent.

symbols.name: find_index
symbols.description: Returns the position of the first element the block accepts, or -1 if none does.

symbols.name: any
symbols.description: Returns true if the block accepts at least one element of the slice.

symbols.name: all
symbols.description: Returns true if the block accepts every element of the slice, including when empty.

symbols.name: any
symbols.description: Returns true if any bool in the slice is true.

symbols.name: all
symbols.description: Returns true if every bool in the slice is true, including when empty.

symbols.name: count
symbols.description: Returns how many elements of the slice equal v.

symbols.name: count
symbols.description: Returns how many elements of the slice the block accepts.

symbols.name: count
symbols.description: Returns the number of non-overlapping occurrences of sub in the byte string.

symbols.name: min
symbols.description: Returns the smallest element of a non-empty slice.

symbols.name: max
symbols.description: Returns the largest element of a non-empty slice.

symbols.name: min
symbols.description: Returns the smallest element of a non-empty slice, using a block that says whether a orders before b.

symbols.name: max
symbols.description: Returns the largest element of a non-empty slice, using a block that says whether a orders before b.

symbols.name: min_by
symbols.description: Returns the index of the element with the smallest key from the block, or -1 if empty.

symbols.name: max_by
symbols.description: Returns the index of the element with the largest key from the block, or -1 if empty.

symbols.name: last
symbols.description: Returns a reference to the last element of the slice.

symbols.name: elem
symbols.description: Returns the element at index i of the slice.

symbols.name: lower_bound
symbols.description: Returns the first index where the block turns false, for a block true on a prefix.

symbols.name: binary_search
symbols.signature: binary_search<T>(xs T[:], v T) int, bool
symbols.description: Returns where v is or would be inserted in a sorted slice, and whether it is present.

symbols.name: starts_with
symbols.description: Returns true if the slice begins with the elements of p.

symbols.name: ends_with
symbols.description: Reports whether a slice ends with the given suffix slice, returning false when the suffix is longer.

symbols.name: startswith
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte string begins with the given prefix, as a Python-style alias of starts_with.

symbols.name: endswith
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte string ends with the given suffix, as a Python-style alias of ends_with.

symbols.name: each_rev
symbols.description: Calls the block on each element of a slice, from last to first.

symbols.name: each_chunk
symbols.description: Calls the block with consecutive sub-slices of n elements, where the last piece may be shorter.

symbols.name: map
symbols.description: Returns a new array holding the block's result for each element of a slice.

symbols.name: filter
symbols.description: Returns a new array of the elements for which the block returns true, in order.

symbols.name: fold
symbols.signature: fold<T, A, F>(xs T[:], acc A) A
symbols.description: Combines the elements of a slice into one value by applying the block to a running accumulator, starting from acc.

symbols.name: sum
symbols.description: Returns the sum of all elements, or the default value of the type for an empty slice.

symbols.name: prod
symbols.description: Returns the product of all elements, or one for an empty slice.

symbols.name: mean
symbols.description: Returns the arithmetic mean of the elements as a real number.

symbols.name: median
symbols.description: Returns the median of the elements as a real, averaging the two middle values for even lengths.

symbols.name: concat
symbols.description: Returns a new array holding the elements of a followed by those of b.

symbols.name: fill
symbols.description: Sets every element of a slice to the given value.

symbols.name: copy_into
symbols.description: Copies elements from src into dst, stopping at the shorter of the two lengths.

symbols.name: reverse
symbols.description: Reverses the elements of a slice in place.

symbols.name: reversed
symbols.description: Returns a new array with the elements of a slice in reverse order.

symbols.name: swap_at
symbols.signature: swap_at<T>(xs T[:], i int, j int)
symbols.description: Swaps the elements at two indices of a slice by moving them without extra copies.

symbols.name: taken
symbols.description: Returns an owned copy of the element at index i.

symbols.name: list
symbols.description: Returns a new growable array copied from a slice.

symbols.name: list
symbols.description: Returns a growable list of owned strings copied from a list of string slices.

symbols.name: zip
symbols.signature: zip<A, B>(a A[:], b B[:]) tuple2<A, B>[>..]
symbols.description: Returns an array of pairs from two slices, stopping at the shorter length.

symbols.name: push_n
symbols.signature: push_n<A, T>(xs A&, v T, n int)
symbols.description: Appends n copies of a value to a growable array.

symbols.name: extend
symbols.description: Appends all elements of a slice to a growable array.

symbols.name: extend
symbols.description: Appends one byte, given as an int, to a growable byte array.

symbols.name: insert_at
symbols.signature: insert_at<A, T>(xs A&, i int, v T)
symbols.description: Inserts a value at index i of a growable array, shifting later elements up.

symbols.name: remove_at
symbols.description: Removes the element at index i, closing the gap, and returns it.

symbols.name: swap_remove
symbols.description: Removes the element at index i by moving the last element into its place, and returns it.

symbols.name: pop_at
symbols.description: Removes and returns the element at index i of a growable array.

symbols.name: pop_at
symbols.description: Removes and returns the last element of a growable array.

symbols.name: pop_front
symbols.description: Removes and returns the first element of a growable array.

symbols.name: push_front
symbols.description: Inserts a value at the front of a growable array.

symbols.name: remove_value
symbols.description: Removes the first element equal to the given value, doing nothing if none is found.

symbols.name: retain
symbols.description: Keeps only the elements the block accepts, preserving their order.

symbols.name: dedup
symbols.description: Drops each element equal to the one just before it, collapsing runs of duplicates.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice in place using a block that says whether a comes before b; not stable.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice in place in ascending order; not stable.

symbols.name: radix_key
symbols.signature: radix_key(k u64, d int, top int) int
symbols.description: Returns the radix bucket for byte position d of a key, flipping the top byte's high bit for signed keys.

symbols.name: radix_sort
symbols.signature: radix_sort<T>(xs T[:], nb int, sgn bool)
symbols.description: Sorts a fixed-width integer slice by byte-wise radix passes, falling back to comparison sort for short slices.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice of u8 values in ascending order.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice of i8 values in ascending order.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice of u16 values in ascending order.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice of i16 values in ascending order.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice of u32 values in ascending order.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice of i32 values in ascending order.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice of u64 values in ascending order.

symbols.name: sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice of i64 values in ascending order.

symbols.name: stable_sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice in place with a block comparing two elements, keeping equal elements in their original order.

symbols.name: stable_sort
symbols.description: Sorts a slice in place in ascending order, keeping equal elements in their original order.

symbols.name: sorted
symbols.description: Returns a new array with the elements of a slice in ascending order, leaving the original unchanged.

symbols.name: sorted
symbols.description: Returns a new array sorted by the block's ordering, leaving the original slice unchanged.

symbols.name: seq
symbols.signature: seq<T, F>(n int, a0 T, a1 T) T
symbols.description: Returns term n of a recurrence where each term is the block applied to the previous two.

symbols.name: seq
symbols.signature: seq<T, F>(n int, a0 T) T
symbols.description: Returns term n of a recurrence where each term is the block applied to the previous one.

symbols.name: tab
symbols.description: Builds a table of n values by calling the block with each index.

symbols.name: tab
symbols.description: Builds an n by m table in row order by calling the block with each row and column index.

symbols.name: each_sum
symbols.description: Fills each output element with the sum of the block's values over m columns, matching a nested loop exactly.

symbols.name: counter
symbols.description: Returns the starting value of a count, used when the compiler lowers push-and-measure collections to plain counters.

symbols.name: heap_up
symbols.description: Moves the element at an index up a binary heap until the block's ordering is satisfied.

symbols.name: heap_down
symbols.description: Moves the element at an index down a binary heap until the block's ordering is satisfied.

symbols.name: heap_push
symbols.signature: heap_push<A, T, F>(xs A&, v T)
symbols.description: Pushes a value onto a binary heap ordered by the block.

symbols.name: heap_push
symbols.description: Pushes a value onto a min-heap.

symbols.name: heap_pop
symbols.description: Removes and returns the first element of a heap ordered by the block.

symbols.name: heap_pop
symbols.description: Removes and returns the smallest element of a min-heap.

symbols.name: make_heap
symbols.description: Rearranges a growable array into a binary heap ordered by the block.

symbols.name: make_heap
symbols.description: Rearranges a growable array into a min-heap.

symbols.name: is_space
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte is whitespace: a space or a control character from 9 to 13.

symbols.name: isspace
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte is whitespace, as a Python-style alias of is_space.

symbols.name: isdigit
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte is an ASCII digit.

symbols.name: islower
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte is a lowercase ASCII letter.

symbols.name: isupper
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte is an uppercase ASCII letter.

symbols.name: isalpha
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte is an ASCII letter.

symbols.name: isalnum
symbols.description: Reports whether a byte is an ASCII letter or digit.

symbols.name: isdigit
symbols.description: Reports whether a string is non-empty and made only of ASCII digits.

symbols.name: isalpha
symbols.description: Reports whether a string is non-empty and made only of ASCII letters.

symbols.name: islower
symbols.description: Reports whether a string has a lowercase letter and no uppercase letters.

symbols.name: isupper
symbols.description: Reports whether a string has an uppercase letter and no lowercase letters.

symbols.name: lower
symbols.description: Returns the lowercase form of an ASCII letter, or the byte unchanged otherwise.

symbols.name: upper
symbols.description: Returns the uppercase form of an ASCII letter, or the byte unchanged otherwise.

symbols.name: ord
symbols.description: Returns the numeric value of a byte as an int.

symbols.name: ord
symbols.description: Returns an int code unchanged, so ord accepts ints as well as bytes.

symbols.name: ord
symbols.description: Returns the first byte of a string as an int, or 0 for an empty string.

symbols.name: chr
symbols.description: Returns a new string holding the UTF-8 encoding of the given code point.

symbols.name: to_int
symbols.description: Returns the numeric value of a byte as an int.

symbols.name: trim_start
symbols.description: Returns a slice of the string with leading whitespace removed.

symbols.name: trim_end
symbols.description: Returns a slice of the string with trailing whitespace removed.

symbols.name: trim
symbols.description: Returns a slice of the string with leading and trailing whitespace removed.

symbols.name: strip
symbols.description: Returns a slice with leading and trailing whitespace removed, as a Python-style alias of trim.

symbols.name: lstrip
symbols.description: Returns a slice with leading whitespace removed, as a Python-style alias of trim_start.

symbols.name: rstrip
symbols.description: Returns a slice with trailing whitespace removed, as a Python-style alias of trim_end.

symbols.name: lstrip
symbols.description: Returns the slice of s with any leading bytes found in cs removed.

symbols.name: rstrip
symbols.description: Returns the slice of s with any trailing bytes found in cs removed.

symbols.name: strip
symbols.description: Returns the slice of s with bytes found in cs removed from both ends.

symbols.name: each_split
symbols.description: Calls the block with each piece of a string split at a separator byte, including empty pieces.

symbols.name: HXK
symbols.description: Cached CPU capability value, initialized to -1 until first checked by hxk.

symbols.name: hxk
symbols.description: Returns true when the vectorized string fast path is available, checking the CPU once and caching the result.

symbols.name: each_split
symbols.description: Calls the block with each piece of s between occurrences of the separator slice.

symbols.name: each_word
symbols.description: Calls the block with each run of non-space bytes in s, skipping whitespace.

symbols.name: split
symbols.signature: split(s byte[:], sep byte) const byte[:][>..]
symbols.description: Returns the pieces of s separated by a single byte, as slices of s.

symbols.name: split
symbols.signature: split(s byte[:], sep byte[:]) const byte[:][>..]
symbols.description: Returns the pieces of s separated by a separator slice, as slices of s.

symbols.name: words
symbols.description: Returns the whitespace-separated words of s as slices of s.

symbols.name: split
symbols.description: Returns the whitespace-separated words of s, the same as words.

symbols.name: join
symbols.signature: join<T>(out byte[>..]&, parts T[:], sep byte[:])

symbols.name: join
symbols.description: Returns the parts joined into a new array with the separator slice between them.

symbols.name: join
symbols.description: Returns the parts joined into a new array with a single separator byte between them.

symbols.name: join
symbols.description: Returns the bytes of parts joined into a new array with the separator slice between them.

symbols.name: join
symbols.description: Returns the bytes of parts joined into a new array with a single separator byte between them.

symbols.name: compare
symbols.description: Returns a negative, zero or positive int as a sorts before, equal to, or after b.

symbols.name: to_lower
symbols.description: Converts every byte of s to lowercase in place.

symbols.name: to_upper
symbols.description: Converts every byte of s to uppercase in place.

symbols.name: lower
symbols.description: Returns a lowercase copy of s as a new array.

symbols.name: upper
symbols.description: Returns an uppercase copy of s as a new array.

symbols.name: capitalize
symbols.description: Returns a copy of s with the first byte uppercase and the rest lowercase.

symbols.name: title
symbols.description: Returns a copy of s with each word's first letter uppercase and other letters lowercase.

symbols.name: format_replaced
symbols.signature: format_replaced(out byte[>..]&, s byte[:], old byte[:], with byte[:])
symbols.description: Appends s to out with every occurrence of old replaced by with; an empty old matches nothing.

symbols.name: replace
symbols.signature: replace(s byte[:], old byte[:], with byte[:]) byte[>..]
symbols.description: Returns a copy of s with every occurrence of old replaced by with.

symbols.name: replace
symbols.signature: replace(s byte[:], old int, with int) byte[>..]
symbols.description: Returns a copy of s with every byte equal to old replaced by the byte with.

symbols.name: repeat
symbols.description: Returns a new array holding s repeated n times.

symbols.name: concat
symbols.description: Returns a new array holding a followed by b.

symbols.name: concat
symbols.description: Returns a new array holding the byte a followed by b.

symbols.name: concat
symbols.description: Returns a new array holding a followed by the byte b.

symbols.name: concat
symbols.description: Returns a new array holding the two bytes a and b.

symbols.name: ljust
symbols.signature: ljust(s byte[:], w int, f byte = ' ') byte[>..]
symbols.description: Returns s padded on the right with the fill byte up to width w.

symbols.name: rjust
symbols.signature: rjust(s byte[:], w int, f byte = ' ') byte[>..]
symbols.description: Returns s padded on the left with the fill byte up to width w.

symbols.name: center
symbols.signature: center(s byte[:], w int, f byte = ' ') byte[>..]
symbols.description: Returns s centered within width w using the fill byte, with any odd extra padding placed on the left when w is odd.

symbols.name: zfill

symbols.name: push_utf8
symbols.description: Appends the UTF-8 encoding of code point cp to out.

symbols.name: utf8_cont
symbols.description: Returns the byte length of the UTF-8 sequence starting at index i, or 1 for a stray or invalid byte.

symbols.name: each_utf8
symbols.description: Calls the block with each code point decoded from the UTF-8 bytes of s.

symbols.name: digit_value

modules.summary: A hash map from any key type to any value type, with insert, lookup, update, remove and iteration.

symbols.name: dictionary_slot
symbols.signature: struct dictionary_slot<K, V> { key K, val V, state byte }
symbols.description: Slot type holding a key, value and state byte, also yielded when iterating a dictionary's items.

symbols.name: dictionary
symbols.signature: struct dictionary<K, V> { count int = 0, removed int = 0, keys K[>..<] = [], vals V[>..<] = [], states byte[>..<] = [] }
symbols.description: Hash map type from key type K to value type V, using open addressing with linear probing.

symbols.name: probe
symbols.signature: probe<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K) int

symbols.name: rehash
symbols.signature: rehash<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, size int)
symbols.description: Rebuilds the table at the given power-of-two size, reinserting all live entries and dropping removed slots.

symbols.name: place
symbols.signature: place<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K, v0 V) int, bool
symbols.description: Returns the slot index for a key, adding it with the given value when absent, plus whether it was added.

symbols.name: get
symbols.signature: get<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K) V?
symbols.description: Returns the value for a key, or null when the key is absent.

symbols.name: get
symbols.signature: get<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K, fallback V) V
symbols.description: Returns the value for a key, or the given fallback when the key is absent.

symbols.name: contains
symbols.signature: contains<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K) bool
symbols.description: Returns whether the dictionary contains the given key.

symbols.name: insert
symbols.signature: insert<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K, val V) bool
symbols.description: Sets the value for a key, returning true when the key was new.

symbols.name: get_or_insert
symbols.signature: get_or_insert<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K, v0 V) V&
symbols.description: Returns a mutable reference to the key's value, inserting the given initial value when the key is absent.

symbols.name: update
symbols.signature: update<K, V, F>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K, v0 V)
symbols.description: Applies the function F to the key's value in place, first inserting the given initial value when absent.

symbols.name: dict_at
symbols.signature: dict_at<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K) V&
symbols.description: Returns a mutable reference to the key's value for indexing, inserting the default value when absent.

symbols.name: remove
symbols.signature: remove<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, key K) bool
symbols.description: Removes a key from the dictionary, returning false when the key was not present.

symbols.name: clear
symbols.description: Removes all entries from the dictionary while keeping its allocated table.

symbols.name: reserve
symbols.signature: reserve<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&, n int)
symbols.description: Grows the table so the dictionary can hold n entries without rehashing again.

symbols.name: each
symbols.description: Calls the function F with each live key and a mutable reference to its value.

symbols.name: keys
symbols.description: Returns a new array of all keys currently in the dictionary.

symbols.name: values
symbols.description: Returns a new array of all values currently in the dictionary.

symbols.name: items
symbols.signature: items<K, V>(d dictionary<K, V>&) dictionary_slot<K, V>[>..]
symbols.description: Returns a new array of key-value slots for every entry in the dictionary.

symbols.name: truthy
symbols.description: Returns whether the dictionary holds at least one entry.

symbols.name: slot_lt
symbols.signature: slot_lt<K, V>(a dictionary_slot<K, V>, b dictionary_slot<K, V>) bool
symbols.description: Orders two slots by key, breaking ties by value, for sorting.

symbols.name: sorted
symbols.description: Returns the dictionary's keys as a new sorted list in ascending order, using the default key comparison.

symbols.name: sorted
symbols.signature: sorted<K, V, F>(d dictionary<K, V>&) K[>..]
symbols.description: Returns the dictionary's keys as a new sorted list, ordered by the comparison function F supplied as a type parameter.

symbols.name: list
symbols.description: Returns the dictionary's keys as a new list, in table order rather than sorted.

symbols.name: sorted
symbols.signature: sorted<K, V>(xs dictionary_slot<K, V>[:]) dictionary_slot<K, V>[>..]
symbols.description: Returns a new array of the given slots sorted by key, then by value.

symbols.name: pydel

symbols.description: Removes a key from the dictionary, serving as the lowering target for Python-style del statements.

symbols.name: set_add
symbols.description: Adds a key to a set represented as a dictionary with boolean values.

symbols.name: set
symbols.description: Builds a set, a dictionary with boolean values, from the distinct elements of an array.

symbols.name: counter
symbols.description: Builds a dictionary counting how many times each element occurs in an array.

symbols.name: dict_from
symbols.signature: dict_from<K, V>(ks K[:], vs V[:]) dictionary<K, V>
symbols.description: Builds a dictionary pairing each key in one array with the value at the same index in another.

symbols.name: pyfmt
symbols.description: Formats a slot as a Python-style key and value tuple string.

symbols.name: pyfmt
symbols.description: Formats a dictionary as a Python-style brace-delimited string of key-value pairs.

modules.summary: Try a block of code and throw a value out of any depth beneath it.

symbols.name: landing
symbols.description: Runs a body and returns a one-element array holding the thrown value, or an empty array if nothing was thrown.

symbols.name: try
symbols.description: Runs a body and calls the catch block with the thrown value of type E if the body throws.

symbols.name: try
symbols.description: Runs a body and silently stops it if a value of type E is thrown, with no handler.

symbols.name: throw
symbols.description: Throws a value out of any depth, returning immediately to the innermost active try and skipping code in between.

modules.summary: Write JSON text, read it piece by piece with a pull reader, or parse it into a small document tree.

symbols.name: HEXCHARS
symbols.description: Lowercase hexadecimal digit characters used to write \u00XX escapes for control bytes.

symbols.name: format_escaped
symbols.description: Appends s to out with quotes, backslashes and control bytes escaped as JSON requires, without surrounding quotes.

symbols.name: format_string
symbols.description: Appends s to out as a complete quoted JSON string with escapes applied.

symbols.name: format_key
symbols.description: Appends an object member name as a quoted string followed by a colon.

symbols.name: format_bool
symbols.description: Appends the JSON literal true or false to out.

symbols.name: format_null
symbols.description: Appends the JSON literal null to out.

symbols.name: format_int
symbols.description: Appends an integer to out in decimal form.

symbols.name: DIG2
symbols.description: Lookup table of the two-digit decimal strings 00 through 99 used for digit conversion.

symbols.name: digits_of
symbols.description: Fills digits with the shortest digit string that reads back as v and returns its decimal exponent.

symbols.name: dlen17
symbols.description: Returns the number of decimal digits in a value of up to 17 digits.

symbols.name: swar8
symbols.description: Converts eight decimal digits packed in an integer into their ASCII characters in one word.

symbols.name: format_number
symbols.signature: inline format_number(out byte[>..]&, v real, plus_exp bool = false)
symbols.description: Appends a real number to the output buffer as JSON text, writing "null" for NaN or infinity and ".0" on whole values; plus_exp adds a "+" to positive exponents.

symbols.name: format_finite
symbols.signature: format_finite(out byte[>..]&, b uint, plus_exp bool)
symbols.description: Appends the shortest-digit form of a finite real, given its raw bits, to the output buffer; helper for format_number.

symbols.name: Reader
symbols.signature: struct Reader { text const byte[:], pos int = 0, error byte[>..] = [], error_at int = -1, key byte[>..] = [] }
symbols.description: Pull reader over JSON text that tracks its position and keeps the first error with its byte offset.

symbols.name: reader
symbols.description: Returns a new reader positioned at the start of text.

symbols.name: ok
symbols.description: Returns whether the reader has encountered no error so far.

symbols.name: fail
symbols.description: Records the first error with its byte offset and moves the reader to the end of the text.

symbols.name: message
symbols.description: Returns the recorded error as a message including the byte offset where it occurred.

symbols.name: white
symbols.description: Returns whether a byte is JSON white space.

symbols.name: peek
symbols.description: Skips white space and returns the next byte, or 0 at the end of the text.

symbols.name: finish
symbols.description: Returns true when the text held exactly one value with nothing after it, otherwise records an error.

symbols.name: expect
symbols.description: Consumes the expected byte after white space, or records an error and returns false.

symbols.name: literal
symbols.signature: literal(r Reader&, word const byte[:]) bool
symbols.description: Consumes the given word at the current position, or records an error and returns false.

symbols.name: number_end
symbols.description: Finds the end of a JSON number at the current position and whether it had a fraction or exponent, or -1.

symbols.name: read_number
symbols.description: Reads a JSON number as a real, recording an error and returning 0.0 if none is present.

symbols.name: read_int
symbols.description: Reads a whole-number JSON value as an int, recording an error if it is fractional or out of range.

symbols.name: read_bool
symbols.description: Reads true or false, recording an error and returning false if neither is present.

symbols.name: read_null
symbols.description: Reads the literal null and returns whether it was present.

symbols.name: hex4
symbols.description: Parses four hexadecimal digits at a position into a value, or returns -1 if invalid.

symbols.name: decode
symbols.description: Decodes the JSON string at the current position into a cleared buffer, returning false on error.

symbols.name: read_string
symbols.signature: read_string(r Reader&, scratch byte[>..]&) const byte[:]
symbols.description: Reads the string at the current position, decoding escapes into scratch, and returns the decoded bytes.

symbols.name: each_member
symbols.description: Calls the block with each member name of an object; the block must read or skip the value.

symbols.name: each_element
symbols.description: Calls the block for each element of an array; the block must read or skip the element.

symbols.name: skip_value
symbols.description: Skips one value of any kind and returns whether the reader is still free of errors.

symbols.name: K_NULL
symbols.description: Node kind constant for a JSON null value.

symbols.name: K_BOOL
symbols.description: Node kind constant for a JSON boolean value.

symbols.name: K_INT
symbols.description: Node kind constant for a number written as a whole value that fits in an int.

symbols.name: K_NUM
symbols.description: Node kind constant for a JSON number stored as a real.

symbols.name: K_STR
symbols.description: Node kind constant for a JSON string value.

symbols.name: K_ARR
symbols.description: Node kind constant for a JSON array.

symbols.name: K_OBJ
symbols.description: Node kind constant for a JSON object.

symbols.name: value

symbols.name: element

symbols.name: kind

symbols.name: as_i64

symbols.name: as_u64

symbols.name: as_bool
symbols.signature: as_bool(d Doc&, n int) bool, bool

symbols.name: as_string
symbols.signature: as_string(d Doc&, n int) const byte[:], bool

symbols.name: is_null

symbols.name: set_name

symbols.name: new_obj
symbols.description: Creates an empty object node and returns its index.

symbols.name: new_arr
symbols.description: Creates an empty array node and returns its index.

symbols.name: new_null
symbols.description: Creates a null node and returns its index.

symbols.name: new_str

symbols.name: new_int

symbols.name: new_num

symbols.name: new_bool

symbols.name: last_of

symbols.name: each

symbols.description: Updates streaming each frame by choosing target levels, applying the memory budget and rebuilding textures.

symbols.name: warm
symbols.description: Ensures a texture reference's image is uploaded to the GPU.

symbols.name: ext_fill
symbols.signature: ext_fill(s int, layer int, src gfx::Texture)
symbols.description: Copies a source texture into one layer of an extended material array.

symbols.name: ext_make
symbols.description: Allocates an extended material array with the given layer capacity and refills its layers.

symbols.name: ext_need
symbols.description: Ensures a material texture has a layer in the extended array, growing it if needed.

symbols.name: ext_finish
symbols.description: Creates any missing extended arrays and regenerates mips for those that changed.

symbols.name: ext_layer
symbols.signature: ext_layer(r gltf::TexRef, s int, none_is int) f32
symbols.description: Returns the array layer of a texture as a float, or the given fallback when it has none.

symbols.name: ext_set
symbols.signature: ext_set(u ExtU&, i int, r gltf::TexRef, s int)
symbols.description: Writes a texture's transform and layer into slot i of an extended material uniform block.

symbols.name: ext_of
symbols.description: Builds the extended-material uniform block from a glTF material's specular, coat, transmission, anisotropy and iridescence settings.

symbols.name: warm_textures
symbols.description: Creates every texture the batch will sample before the first render pass.

symbols.name: wrap_mode
symbols.description: Converts a glTF wrap constant to a gfx wrap mode.

symbols.name: texture_sampler
symbols.description: Returns a cached sampler matching a glTF texture's filtering and wrapping.

symbols.name: bind_slot
symbols.signature: bind_slot(slot int, r gltf::TexRef, srgb bool, fallback gfx::Texture)
symbols.description: Binds a material texture slot, using a fallback texture when the reference has no image.

symbols.name: material_of
symbols.description: Returns the material for a primitive, or the default material when none is set.

symbols.name: cut_of
symbols.description: Builds the alpha cutout uniform data from a material.

symbols.name: find_prev
symbols.description: Returns the index of a node key in last frame's list, or -1 if absent.

symbols.name: in_view
symbols.signature: in_view(m gfx::mat4, lo float3, hi float3) bool
symbols.description: Returns whether a bounding box is at least partly inside the view frustum.

symbols.name: atmosphere
symbols.signature: atmosphere(to_sun float3, power f32, haze f32, clouds f32)
symbols.description: Sets the sun direction, color and sky from a sun direction, power, haze and cloud amount.

symbols.name: item_lights
symbols.description: Registers or updates the lights defined by an item's glTF nodes, and applies any directional light to the sun.

symbols.name: frustum
symbols.description: Extracts the six normalized frustum clip planes from a view-projection matrix for culling instances against the camera.

symbols.name: gather_instances
symbols.description: Flattens instance sets into per-frame draw batches, culling against the view frustum, splitting LODs, and uploading instance ids and transforms to GPU buffers.

symbols.name: gather
symbols.description: Flattens visible items into draw batches with poses, joint palettes and previous-frame transforms.

symbols.name: forward
symbols.description: Returns the unit vector from the camera eye toward its target.

symbols.name: mw
symbols.signature: mw(pool f32[:], base int, j int, n int) f32
symbols.description: Returns a morph target weight from a pool, or 0.0 when the base is negative or the index is out of range.

symbols.name: draw_uniforms
symbols.description: Builds per-draw uniform data for a batch, including morph weights and previous transforms.

symbols.name: bind_geometry
symbols.description: Binds the shared vertex, index and storage buffers for geometry drawing.

symbols.name: draw_prim
symbols.description: Draws one primitive's indexed geometry from a batch.

symbols.name: halton
symbols.description: Returns the Halton sequence value of an index in a base, used for jitter.

symbols.name: setup_view
symbols.description: Computes view and projection matrices, lens offset and temporal sub-pixel jitter for the frame.

symbols.name: setup_cascades
symbols.description: Fits orthographic shadow cascades to view frustum slices with texel snapping.

symbols.name: fill_frame
symbols.description: Fills the per-frame uniform block with cascades, sun, sky, lights and global illumination settings.

symbols.name: image_avg
symbols.description: Returns an image's mean linear color from sparse samples, used as bounce albedo.

symbols.name: gi_scene
symbols.description: Builds the ray-tracing scene from batch geometry and sets up the irradiance probe grid.

symbols.name: gi_rot
symbols.description: Returns a pseudo-random rotation uniform for the given probe update index.

symbols.name: gi_pass
symbols.description: Runs compute passes that trace probe rays and update irradiance and distance data.

symbols.name: signed_range
symbols.description: Returns a light's range as positive, or negative when its falloff mode is 1, clamped to at least 0.01.

symbols.name: light_upload
symbols.description: Uploads the light list and its camera-cluster assignments to GPU storage buffers, growing them when needed.

symbols.name: gi_bind
symbols.description: Binds ray-tracing and probe storage buffers, or dummy buffers when unavailable.

symbols.name: shadow_pass
symbols.description: Renders the sun shadow cascades into the depth map from the batch.

symbols.name: shelter_pass
symbols.description: Renders a top-down depth map around the eye so weather effects can tell which pixels are sheltered from above.

symbols.name: local_shadow_pass
symbols.description: Renders depth layers for shadow-casting local lights, skipping blended and no-shadow materials and off-screen geometry.

symbols.name: fullscreen
symbols.description: Binds a pipeline for a fullscreen draw.

symbols.name: sky_u
symbols.description: Builds the sky uniform data from the view and sun settings.

symbols.name: ao_pass
symbols.description: Runs the prepass for normals, depth and motion, then computes and blurs ambient occlusion.

symbols.name: contact_on
symbols.description: Returns whether contact shadows are enabled, which requires sun shadows on and a positive contact strength.

symbols.name: contact_pass
symbols.description: Renders a screen-space contact shadow texture toward the sun from the depth and normal prepass.

symbols.name: ssr_pass
symbols.description: Builds a depth hierarchy and traces screen-space reflection hits, updating the reflection uniforms.

symbols.name: ssgi_live
symbols.description: Returns whether screen-space GI is active, meaning it is enabled while baked GI and probe capture are off.

symbols.name: ssgi_pass
symbols.description: Traces, accumulates and upsamples screen-space indirect light each frame, publishing the result to the frame uniforms when it succeeds.

symbols.name: ssr_capture
symbols.description: Copies the resolved color into a mipmapped image for reflections to sample next frame.

symbols.name: cut_cover
symbols.description: Returns whether a material is alpha-masked and alpha-to-coverage is enabled, so cut-out edges use coverage.

symbols.name: lit_pipe
symbols.description: Picks the lit pipeline for a material, using the cut-out variant when alpha-to-coverage applies and the two-sided variant when double sided.

symbols.name: mip_scale
symbols.description: Returns the texture mip scale from the output-to-render width ratio when auto bias is on, combined with the manual mip bias.

symbols.name: surface_of
symbols.description: Builds the surface uniform data from a material.

symbols.name: draw_lit
symbols.description: Draws one batch item with lit shading, binding its uniforms and textures.

symbols.name: trans_capture
symbols.description: Copies the scene color into a mipmapped texture that transmissive materials sample for refraction.

symbols.name: color_pass
symbols.description: Renders the sky, opaque, blended and particle surfaces into the multisampled color target.

symbols.name: lens_tiles
symbols.description: Builds per-tile lens data from the source texture for depth of field and motion blur.

symbols.name: lens_swap
symbols.description: Swaps the working HDR and effects textures so the next lens pass reads the latest result.

symbols.name: fog_pass
symbols.description: Raymarches volumetric fog through the scene, lit by the sun cascades and point lights, then swaps buffers.

symbols.name: lens_pass
symbols.description: Applies motion blur from motion vectors and depth of field to the HDR image when each effect is enabled.

symbols.name: temporal_draw
symbols.description: Draws one temporal accumulation pass into the inactive history image and makes it current.

symbols.name: temporal_pass
symbols.description: Runs the temporal accumulation decision, skipping and invalidating history when temporal is off, otherwise drawing and validating it.

symbols.name: temporal_repeat
symbols.description: Repeats only the temporal pass a given number of times on the last frame's inputs, for timing.

symbols.name: glow_pass
symbols.description: Builds the bloom chain by thresholding the resolved image, downsampling, then upsampling back to full size.

symbols.name: set_lut
symbols.signature: set_lut(rgba const byte[:], n int) bool
symbols.description: Replaces the color grading lookup table from n×n×n RGBA8 texels; returns false if n is under 2 or data is too short.

symbols.name: identity_lut
symbols.description: Installs a neutral identity color grading lookup table of size n per axis, leaving colors unchanged.

symbols.name: lut_strip
symbols.signature: lut_strip(rgba const byte[:], w int, h int) bool
symbols.description: Loads a color grading lookup table from a strip image whose width equals height squared; returns false otherwise.

symbols.name: lut_cube
symbols.description: Parses a .cube text file into the color grading lookup table; returns false if the size or data is invalid.

symbols.name: exposure_pass
symbols.description: Runs the compute passes that build a luminance histogram and adapt the automatic exposure value each frame.

symbols.name: exposure_now
symbols.description: Returns the current automatic exposure multiplier read back from the GPU, or 1.0 if the read fails.

symbols.name: grade_pass
symbols.description: Writes the resolved image with bloom, exposure, tone curve and desaturation applied into the target texture.

symbols.name: probe_capture
symbols.description: Sorts probes by volume and captures the scene into the environment cube maps used for reflections.

symbols.name: render
symbols.description: Renders the whole scene for one frame into the given RGBA8 target and advances the frame counter.

symbols.name: render_begin
symbols.description: Runs the first half of a frame through color and fog passes; returns false if the renderer is not ready.

symbols.name: render_end
symbols.description: Finishes the frame with lens, temporal, bloom, exposure and grading passes into the given RGBA8 target.

modules.summary: Load glTF 2.0 models (`.glb` and `.gltf`) into memory pools the renderer uploads in one go.

symbols.name: VERTEX_FLOATS
symbols.description: Number of floats in each loaded vertex: position, normal, two UV sets, tangent, color, joints and weights.

symbols.name: AT_POS
symbols.description: Float offset of the position (3 floats) within a vertex.

symbols.name: AT_NRM
symbols.description: Float offset of the normal (3 floats) within a vertex.

symbols.name: AT_UV0
symbols.description: Float offset of the first UV set (2 floats) within a vertex.

symbols.name: AT_UV1
symbols.description: Float offset of the second UV set (2 floats) within a vertex.

symbols.name: AT_TAN
symbols.description: Float offset of the tangent (4 floats, w is handedness) within a vertex.

symbols.name: AT_COL
symbols.description: Float offset of the RGBA vertex color (4 floats) within a vertex.

symbols.name: AT_JOINT
symbols.description: Float offset of the four joint indices within a vertex.

symbols.name: AT_WEIGHT
symbols.description: Float offset of the four skinning weights within a vertex.

symbols.name: MORPH_FLOATS
symbols.description: Number of floats in one morph target delta: position xyz, padding, normal xyz, padding.

symbols.name: ALPHA_OPAQUE
symbols.description: Alpha mode value for a fully opaque material.

symbols.name: ALPHA_MASK
symbols.description: Alpha mode value for a material that discards pixels below its alpha cutoff.

symbols.name: ALPHA_BLEND
symbols.description: Alpha mode value for a material blended with what is behind it.

symbols.name: PATH_T
symbols.description: Channel path value for animating a node's translation.

symbols.name: PATH_R
symbols.description: Channel path value for animating a node's rotation.

symbols.name: PATH_S
symbols.description: Channel path value for animating a node's scale.

symbols.name: PATH_W
symbols.description: Channel path value for animating a node's morph target weights.

symbols.name: STEP_LINEAR
symbols.description: Interpolation mode that blends linearly between keyframes.

symbols.name: STEP_HOLD
symbols.description: Interpolation mode that holds each keyframe value until the next one.

symbols.name: STEP_CUBIC
symbols.description: Interpolation mode that uses cubic spline tangents between keyframes.

symbols.name: Span
symbols.signature: struct Span { first int, count int }
symbols.description: Range of items in a pool, given by a first index and a count.

symbols.name: TexRef
symbols.signature: struct TexRef { texture int, uv int, m float4 = float4 { 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0 }, o float2 = float2 { 0.0, 0.0 } }
symbols.description: Reference to a texture and the UV set used to sample it, with -1 meaning none.

symbols.name: Material

	base float4, base_tex TexRef,

	ext bool = false, ior f32 = 1.5, spec_f f32 = 1.0, spec_c float3 = float3 { 1.0, 1.0, 1.0 }, spec_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 }, spec_c_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 },
	coat f32 = 0.0, coat_r f32 = 0.0, coat_ns f32 = 1.0, coat_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 }, coat_r_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 }, coat_n_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 },
	trans f32 = 0.0, trans_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 }, thick f32 = 0.0, thick_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 }, att_d f32 = 0.0, att_c float3 = float3 { 1.0, 1.0, 1.0 },
	height_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 }, height_scale f32 = 0.0,

	irid f32 = 0.0, irid_ior f32 = 1.3, irid_min f32 = 100.0, irid_max f32 = 400.0, irid_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 }, irid_t_tex TexRef = TexRef { -1, 0 },

symbols.description: Surface description holding color, metallic, roughness, texture references, emissive, alpha mode and extra layering options.

symbols.name: Primitive
symbols.signature: struct Primitive { vfirst int, vcount int, ifirst int, icount int, material int, mfirst int, targets int, lo float3, hi float3, tangents bool, skinned bool }
symbols.description: Record for one mesh primitive with its vertex, index and morph ranges, material, bounds and skinning flags.

symbols.name: PLight
symbols.signature: struct PLight { kind int, rgb float3, range f32, inner f32, outer f32 }
symbols.description: Describes one punctual light from the asset, with kind, color, range and inner and outer cone angles.

symbols.name: Mesh
symbols.signature: struct Mesh { prims Span, weights Span, name Span }
symbols.description: Mesh made of a range of primitives, with default morph weights and a name.

symbols.name: Node
symbols.signature: struct Node { parent int, mesh int, skin int, children Span, t float3, r linalg::Quat, s float3, matrix gfx::mat4, has_matrix bool, weights Span, name Span, light int = -1 }
symbols.description: Scene graph node with parent, mesh, skin, children, transform, morph weights and name.

symbols.name: Texture
symbols.signature: struct Texture { image int, mag_nearest bool, min_nearest bool, mipmaps bool, wrap_s int, wrap_t int }
symbols.description: Texture record naming its image, filtering, mipmap use and wrap modes.

symbols.name: Image
symbols.signature: struct Image { width int, height int, pixels Span, ok bool, coded Span = Span { 0, 0 }, ktx bool = false }
symbols.description: Decoded image with width, height, RGBA pixel range and a flag telling whether decoding succeeded.

symbols.name: Skin
symbols.signature: struct Skin { joints Span, inverse_binds Span, skeleton int, name Span }
symbols.description: Skin with joint nodes, inverse bind matrices, optional skeleton root and name.

symbols.name: Channel
symbols.signature: struct Channel { node int, path int, interp int, times Span, values Span, width int }
symbols.description: Animation channel targeting one node path, with interpolation, keyframe times and values.

symbols.name: Animation
symbols.signature: struct Animation { channels Span, duration f32, name Span }
symbols.description: Named animation made of a range of channels and its duration in seconds.

symbols.name: Asset
symbols.signature: struct Asset { meshes Span, nodes Span, materials Span, textures Span, images Span, skins Span, animations Span, roots Span, ok bool }
symbols.description: Loaded asset holding ranges into every pool for its meshes, nodes, materials, textures, images, skins, animations and roots.

symbols.name: verts
symbols.description: Global pool of vertex floats for all loaded primitives.

symbols.name: indices
symbols.description: Global pool of triangle indices for all loaded primitives.

symbols.name: morphs
symbols.description: Global pool of morph target delta floats.

symbols.name: floats
symbols.description: Global pool of miscellaneous floats, such as weights, keyframe times and keyframe values.

symbols.name: ints
symbols.description: Global pool of integer indices, such as node children, joints and scene roots.

symbols.name: matrices
symbols.description: Global pool of inverse bind matrices for skins.

symbols.name: pixels
symbols.description: Global pool of decoded RGBA image pixel bytes.

symbols.name: lazy_pixels
symbols.description: Flag that, when true, keeps images compressed and defers pixel decoding until needed.

symbols.name: bad_images
symbols.description: Counts images that failed to decode and were replaced by placeholder pixels.

symbols.name: coded
symbols.description: Pool of still-compressed PNG or JPEG image bytes kept for lazily decoded images.

symbols.name: decoded
symbols.description: Scratch buffer holding RGBA pixels of the most recently decoded lazy image.

symbols.name: decoded_of
symbols.description: Index of the image currently held in the decoded buffer, or -1 for none.

symbols.name: names
symbols.description: Global pool of name text referenced by spans.

symbols.name: meshes
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded meshes.

symbols.name: prims
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded mesh primitives.

symbols.name: nodes
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded scene nodes.

symbols.name: materials
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded materials.

symbols.name: plights
symbols.description: Pool of all punctual lights read from loaded assets.

symbols.name: textures
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded textures.

symbols.name: images
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded images.

symbols.name: skins
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded skins.

symbols.name: channels
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded animation channels.

symbols.name: animations
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded animations.

symbols.name: assets
symbols.description: Global pool of all loaded assets, indexed by the value returned from loading.

symbols.name: problem
symbols.description: Buffer holding the most recent load error message.

symbols.name: skipped_prims
symbols.signature: var skipped_prims int[>..];   // one counter: point and line primitives are not loaded
symbols.description: Single-element counter of point and line primitives skipped during loading.

symbols.name: blob
symbols.description: Scratch buffer of binary data for the asset currently being read.

symbols.name: buf_at
symbols.description: Scratch list of each buffer's start offset in the blob.

symbols.name: buf_len
symbols.description: Scratch list of each buffer's length in bytes.

symbols.name: view_at
symbols.description: Scratch list of each buffer view's start offset in the blob.

symbols.name: view_len
symbols.description: Scratch list of each buffer view's length in bytes.

symbols.name: view_stride
symbols.description: Scratch list of each buffer view's byte stride, with 0 meaning tightly packed.

symbols.name: accessor_node
symbols.description: Scratch list of JSON node indices for each accessor of the asset being read.

symbols.name: error
symbols.description: Returns the message describing the most recent load failure.

symbols.name: skipped
symbols.description: Returns how many point and line primitives were skipped because they are not loaded.

symbols.name: fail
symbols.description: Records an error message and returns -1.

symbols.name: reset
symbols.description: Clears every asset pool and the error state, discarding all loaded assets.

symbols.name: text_of
symbols.description: Returns the name text a span refers to.

symbols.name: keep_name
symbols.description: Stores a name in the name pool and returns its span.

symbols.name: get
symbols.signature: get(d json::Doc&, n int, key const byte[:]) int
symbols.description: Returns the JSON child node for a key of an object, or -1 if missing.

symbols.name: num
symbols.signature: num(d json::Doc&, n int, key const byte[:], fallback real) real
symbols.description: Returns a numeric JSON member, or the fallback if absent or not a number.

symbols.name: whole
symbols.signature: whole(d json::Doc&, n int, key const byte[:], fallback int) int
symbols.description: Returns a JSON member as an integer, or the fallback if absent or not a number.

symbols.name: truth
symbols.signature: truth(d json::Doc&, n int, key const byte[:], fallback bool) bool
symbols.description: Returns a boolean JSON member, or the fallback if absent or not a boolean.

symbols.name: word
symbols.signature: word(d json::Doc&, n int, key const byte[:]) const byte[:]
symbols.description: Returns a string JSON member, or an empty string if absent or not a string.

symbols.name: children_of
symbols.signature: children_of(d json::Doc&, n int, out int[>..]&)
symbols.description: Collects the child node indices of a JSON node into an output list.

symbols.name: item_num
symbols.signature: item_num(d json::Doc&, arr int, k int, fallback real) real
symbols.description: Returns the numeric element at an index of a JSON array, or the fallback.

symbols.name: u32le
symbols.signature: u32le(b const byte[:], o int) int
symbols.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit integer from a byte slice at an offset.

symbols.name: hexval
symbols.description: Converts a hexadecimal digit character to its value, or -1 if invalid.

symbols.name: fetch_uri
symbols.signature: fetch_uri(uri const byte[:], dir const byte[:], out byte[>..]&) bool
symbols.description: Appends the bytes a URI refers to, decoding data URIs or reading a file relative to a directory; false on failure.

symbols.name: component_size
symbols.description: Returns the byte size of a glTF component type code, or 0 if unknown.

symbols.name: type_shape
symbols.description: Returns the column and row counts of a glTF accessor type name, or 0 and 0 if unknown.

symbols.name: component
symbols.signature: component(o int, kind int, normalized bool) real
symbols.description: Reads one component from the buffer blob at an offset and converts it to a real, normalizing if requested.

symbols.name: read_accessor
symbols.signature: read_accessor<T>(d json::Doc&, index int, out T[>..]&) int, int, bool
symbols.description: Appends all elements of an accessor to an output list, returning count, values per element and success.

symbols.name: load
symbols.description: Loads a glTF or GLB file into the pools and returns its asset index, or -1 on failure.

symbols.name: texref
symbols.signature: texref(d json::Doc&, n int, tex_base int) TexRef
symbols.description: Builds a texture reference from a JSON texture info object, offset by the asset's texture base.

symbols.name: need_pixels
symbols.description: Decodes the lazy image at the given index into the shared buffer, substituting white pixels on failure.

symbols.name: image_pixels
symbols.description: Returns the RGBA pixels of an image, or an empty slice if a lazy image is not yet decoded.

symbols.name: image_file

symbols.name: decode_image

symbols.name: presize
symbols.description: Reserves vertex and index pool capacity for large assets before parsing, based on accessor counts.

symbols.name: load_bytes
symbols.signature: load_bytes(data const byte[:], dir const byte[:]) int

symbols.name: add_texture_file

symbols.name: add_image

symbols.name: add_texture_ktx2

symbols.description: Adds raw RGBA pixel data of the given width and height as a texture with the given wrap mode, returning its index.

symbols.name: find_node
symbols.signature: find_node(asset int, name const byte[:]) int
symbols.description: Returns the index of the node with the given name in an asset, or -1 if none.

symbols.name: in_place
symbols.description: Removes horizontal root motion from an animation's node translation and returns the distance it drifted.

symbols.name: find_animation
symbols.signature: find_animation(asset int, name const byte[:]) int

modules.summary: Build a bounding volume tree of triangles for ray tracing, upload it to the GPU, and test rays against it.

symbols.description: Constant giving the number of bins used to evaluate surface-area-heuristic split candidates per axis.

symbols.name: LEAF
symbols.description: Constant giving the maximum number of triangles a leaf node holds before a split is attempted.

symbols.name: NODE_FLOATS
symbols.description: Constant giving the number of floats each tree node occupies in the node array.

symbols.name: TRI_FLOATS
symbols.description: Constant giving the number of floats each triangle occupies in the triangle array.

symbols.name: alb_in
symbols.description: Input array of per-triangle albedo colors, three floats per triangle, parallel to the triangle input.

symbols.description: Accumulates per-triangle glow and packed metalness and roughness values that add appends, consumed when the tree is built.

symbols.name: nodes
symbols.description: Flattened array of tree nodes holding bounds, child or leaf data, produced by build.

symbols.name: tris
symbols.description: Flattened array of reordered triangle data with edge vectors and albedo, produced by build.

symbols.name: order
symbols.description: Working array of triangle indices reordered during splitting so each leaf covers a contiguous range.

symbols.name: cen
symbols.description: Working array of triangle centroids, three floats per triangle, used when binning splits.

symbols.name: node_buf
symbols.description: GPU buffer holding the node array after upload.

symbols.name: tri_buf
symbols.description: GPU buffer holding the triangle array after upload.

symbols.name: has_bufs
symbols.description: Flag recording whether GPU buffers currently exist and must be released before replacement.

symbols.name: ready
symbols.description: Flag that is true once build has produced a usable tree and false when the scene is empty or cleared.

symbols.name: clear
symbols.description: Removes all triangles from the scene and marks the tree as needing a rebuild.

symbols.name: count
symbols.description: Returns the number of triangles currently added to the scene.

symbols.name: add
symbols.signature: add(a float3, b float3, c float3, rgb float3, metal f32, rough f32, glow float3)
symbols.description: Appends one triangle with vertices, albedo color, metalness and roughness clamped to 0..1, and emissive glow to the scene input.

symbols.name: tmin
symbols.description: Returns the smallest coordinate of a triangle's vertices along the given axis.

symbols.name: tmax
symbols.description: Returns the largest coordinate of a triangle's vertices along the given axis.

symbols.name: area
symbols.description: Returns the surface area measure of a bounding box, used as the split cost metric.

symbols.name: set_node
symbols.signature: set_node(n int, lo f32[3], hi f32[3], a int, c int)
symbols.description: Writes a node's bounding box and its child or leaf fields into the node array.

symbols.name: new_node

symbols.name: bounds
symbols.signature: bounds(first int, cnt int) f32[3], f32[3], f32[3], f32[3]

modules.summary: Load and play sounds with voices, 3D positioning, mix buses, reverb and offline rendering.

modules.summary: The clip bank: keyframes at a uniform rate, sampled by time or phase, with additive clips and root motion.

	nj i32, frames i32, fps f32, dur f32, base int,
	looping bool, additive bool,
	root i32,          // root-motion joint, -1 for none

}

symbols.signature:
struct Leg {
	hip i32, knee i32, ankle i32,
	sole f32 = 0.08,       // ankle height above ground when the foot is flat
	locked bool = false,
	lock_pos float3 = V0,  // world position held while locked
	lock_w f32 = 0.0,
	prev float3 = V0,      // last world ankle position (for contact speed)
	has_prev bool = false,
	err f32 = 0.0,
	out_w float3 = V0,     // last world ankle target actually solved for
	out_v float3 = V0,     // its velocity (m/s)
	prev_tw float3 = V0,   // last unlocked (anim + ground) target
	prev_tw_v float3 = V0, // and its velocity
	has_out bool = false,
	// knee-forward direction in the knee joint's frame, captured the first
	// time the leg is clearly bent; gives a pole that follows the shin and
	// does not flip when the animated knee passes through straight
	fwd_k float3 = V0,
	has_fwd bool = false,
	// release: the offset (output - anim target) at the moment of release is
	// decayed to zero by a quintic matching offset and velocity (inertialization)
	releasing bool = false,
	rel_t f32 = 0.0, rel_T f32 = 0.0,
	rel_x0 float3 = V0, rel_v0 float3 = V0,
}

}

modules.summary: Quaternions and rigid transforms for the animation runtime.

symbols.name: QI
symbols.description: Identity quaternion representing no rotation, stored as float4 with w as the scalar part.

symbols.name: V0
symbols.description: Zero vector with all three components set to 0.

symbols.name: V1
symbols.description: Vector with all three components set to 1, used as the unscaled identity scale.

symbols.name: v3
symbols.signature: v3(x f32, y f32, z f32) float3
symbols.description: Builds a float3 from x, y and z components.

symbols.name: q4
symbols.signature: q4(x f32, y f32, z f32, w f32) float4
symbols.description: Builds a float4 quaternion from x, y, z and scalar w components.

symbols.name: qmul
symbols.description: Returns the Hamilton product a*b, which rotates by b first and then by a.

symbols.name: qconj
symbols.description: Returns the conjugate of a quaternion, which is the inverse for unit quaternions.

symbols.name: qdot
symbols.description: Returns the four-component dot product of two quaternions.

symbols.name: qneg
symbols.description: Returns the quaternion with all four components negated, representing the same rotation.

symbols.name: qnorm
symbols.description: Returns the quaternion scaled to unit length, or identity if its squared length is nearly zero.

symbols.name: qrot
symbols.description: Returns a vector rotated by a unit quaternion.

symbols.name: qaxis
symbols.description: Builds a quaternion rotating by an angle in radians about an axis, or identity for a zero axis.

symbols.name: qfromto
symbols.description: Builds the shortest rotation taking direction a onto direction b, or identity if either is near zero length.

symbols.name: qangle
symbols.description: Returns the angle in radians, from 0 to pi, of the rotation taking one quaternion to another.

symbols.name: nlerp
symbols.signature: nlerp(a float4, b float4, t f32) float4
symbols.description: Returns the normalized linear interpolation between two quaternions on the shorter arc at parameter t.

symbols.name: slerp
symbols.signature: slerp(a float4, b float4, t f32) float4
symbols.description: Returns the spherical linear interpolation between two quaternions on the shorter arc at parameter t.

symbols.name: qyaw
symbols.description: Builds a quaternion rotating by a yaw angle in radians about the +Y axis.

symbols.name: yaw_of
symbols.description: Returns the yaw angle in radians of a rotation's forward +Z axis.

symbols.name: Xf
symbols.signature: struct Xf { t float3, r float4, s float3 }
symbols.description: Rigid transform with translation, rotation quaternion and per-axis scale, mapping p to t + r(s*p).

symbols.name: XI
symbols.signature: let XI = Xf { V0, QI, V1 }
symbols.description: Identity transform with zero translation, identity rotation and unit scale.

symbols.name: xf_point
symbols.description: Returns a point transformed by scale, rotation and translation.

symbols.name: xf_dir
symbols.description: Returns a direction vector rotated by the transform, ignoring translation and scale.

symbols.name: xf_mul
symbols.description: Returns the parent-times-child composition of two transforms, exact only for uniform scale or leaf-only scale.

symbols.name: xf_inv
symbols.description: Returns the inverse of a transform, dividing by its per-axis scale.

symbols.name: M4
symbols.description: Column-major 4x4 matrix of 16 floats in glTF and GPU layout.

symbols.name: m4_of
symbols.description: Builds a column-major 4x4 matrix from a transform's translation, rotation and scale.

symbols.name: m4_mul
symbols.description: Returns the product of two column-major 4x4 matrices.

symbols.name: m4_point
symbols.description: Returns a point transformed by a 4x4 matrix, including translation.

symbols.name: m4_dir
symbols.description: Returns a direction transformed by a 4x4 matrix, ignoring translation.

symbols.name: smoothstep01
symbols.description: Returns a smoothstep curve of x clamped to 0 through 1, easing at both ends.

symbols.name: smootherstep01
symbols.description: Returns a smootherstep curve of x clamped to 0 through 1, with zero first and second derivatives at the ends.

modules.summary: A ready-made walking and running character: speed blending, action states, an upper-body layer, root motion and foot planting.

symbols.signature: var p_a int[>..] = []; var p_b int[>..] = []; var p_d int[>..] = []; var p_q0 float3[>..] = []; var p_q1 float3[>..] = []; var p_next int[>..] = []
symbols.description: Holds portal endpoints, region pairs, directions and list links between adjacent regions.

symbols.name: r_head
symbols.signature: var r_head int[>..] = []; var adj0 int[>..] = []; var adj int[>..] = []
symbols.description: Holds the region adjacency list offsets and entries that reference portals.

symbols.name: poly_a

symbols.description: Holds scratch polygon buffers used during build.

symbols.name: ready

symbols.name: DX
symbols.description: Lists the x offsets of the four neighbor directions on the grid.

symbols.name: DZ

symbols.name: clear
symbols.description: Discards all input triangles and marks the mesh as not ready.

symbols.name: add
symbols.signature: add(a float3, b float3, c float3)
symbols.description: Adds one triangle to the input geometry used by the next build.

symbols.name: cell_count
symbols.description: Returns the total number of walkable cells in the built mesh.

symbols.name: live_cells
symbols.description: Returns the number of cells that belong to a merged rectangle region.

symbols.name: rect_count
symbols.description: Returns the number of merged rectangle regions in the built mesh.

symbols.name: portal_count
symbols.description: Returns the number of portals connecting adjacent regions.

symbols.name: clip
symbols.signature: clip(inp f32[>..]&, n int, out f32[>..]&, axis int, v f32, keep_hi bool) int
symbols.description: Clips a polygon against an axis-aligned plane and returns the resulting vertex count.

symbols.name: add_span
symbols.signature: add_span(c int, lo int, hi int, walk bool, y f32)
symbols.description: Inserts a height span into a grid column, merging it with overlapping spans.

symbols.name: raster
symbols.description: Rasterizes one input triangle into spans of the voxel grid.

symbols.name: link
symbols.description: Returns the neighbor cell index in a given direction, or negative if none.

symbols.name: build
symbols.description: Builds the navigation mesh from the added triangles and returns false if there are none.

symbols.name: locate
symbols.description: Finds the nearest mesh cell to a point and returns its index with the snapped position, or -1 if none.

symbols.name: mid
symbols.description: Returns the midpoint of a portal's edge.

symbols.name: dist
symbols.description: Returns the Euclidean distance between two points.

symbols.name: cross_at

symbols.description: Returns where the segment between two points crosses a portal edge, or the nearer edge endpoint.

symbols.name: cross2
