symbols.description: Returns the signed 2D cross product of two edge vectors on the xz plane.

symbols.name: hpush
symbols.signature: hpush(hk f32[>..]&, hv int[>..]&, k f32, v int)
symbols.description: Pushes a key and value onto a binary min-heap.

symbols.name: hpop
symbols.description: Removes and returns the value with the smallest key from a binary min-heap.

symbols.name: path
symbols.signature: path(a float3, b float3, out float3[>..]&) bool
symbols.description: Finds a path between two points over the mesh, returning false if either point is off the mesh.

modules.summary: Stream a large world: load and unload grid cells in background threads as the player moves.

symbols.name: Req
symbols.signature: struct Req { id int, gen int, delay int, path byte[..128] }
symbols.description: Request sent to a loader thread, carrying cell id, generation, delay and file path.

symbols.name: Chunk
symbols.signature: struct Chunk { id int, gen int, off int, n int, total int, data byte[..8192] }
symbols.description: Chunk of file data sent back from a loader thread, tagged with cell id and generation.

symbols.name: cell_m
symbols.description: Side length of one grid cell in meters, set by the grid function.

symbols.name: load_r
symbols.description: Distance in meters within which cells are requested for loading.

symbols.name: unload_r
symbols.description: Distance in meters beyond which loaded or loading cells are dropped.

symbols.name: inner_r
symbols.description: Distance in meters inside which cells are never evicted to meet the memory budget.

symbols.name: budget
symbols.description: Maximum total bytes of resident cell data before distant cells are evicted.

symbols.name: frame_bytes
symbols.description: Maximum bytes of chunk data copied into cells per update call.

symbols.name: max_inflight
symbols.description: Maximum number of cells loading at the same time.

symbols.name: sync
symbols.description: Flag that, when true, loads cells synchronously on the calling thread instead of using workers.

symbols.name: io_delay_ms
symbols.description: Artificial delay in milliseconds added to each cell read, for simulating slow storage.

symbols.name: gw
symbols.signature: var gw = 0; var gh = 0; var ox f32 = 0.0; var oz f32 = 0.0
symbols.description: Grid width, height and world origin used to map cell indices to positions.

symbols.name: PATHS
symbols.description: Per-cell file paths for the grid.

symbols.name: STATE
symbols.signature: var STATE int[>..] = []; var GEN int[>..] = []; var GOT int[>..] = []; var LOADS int[>..] = []
symbols.description: Per-cell load state, generation, received byte count and completed load count.

symbols.name: DATA
symbols.description: Per-cell buffers holding loaded file data.

symbols.name: WORKERS
symbols.description: Handles of running loader worker threads.

symbols.name: resident
symbols.description: Running total of bytes held by loaded cells.

symbols.name: inflight
symbols.description: Count of cells currently being loaded.

symbols.name: NEW
symbols.description: Queue of cells that finished loading since the last take_new call.

symbols.name: loader
symbols.description: Worker thread body that reads requested files and sends them back in chunks.

symbols.name: grid
symbols.signature: grid(w int, h int, origin_x f32, origin_z f32, cell f32)
symbols.description: Defines the cell grid size, world origin and cell size, resetting all streaming state.

symbols.name: cell_path
symbols.signature: cell_path(cx int, cz int, path const byte[:])
symbols.description: Assigns the file path to load for the cell at the given grid coordinates.

symbols.name: start
symbols.description: Starts the given number of background loader threads.

symbols.name: stop
symbols.description: Stops all loader threads and waits for them to exit.

symbols.name: dist
symbols.signature: dist(k int, x f32, z f32) f32
symbols.description: Returns the distance in meters from a point to the nearest edge of a cell, zero if inside.

symbols.name: drop_cell
symbols.description: Unloads a cell, releasing its data and invalidating any pending load for it.

symbols.name: loaded
symbols.description: Returns whether the cell has finished loading.

symbols.name: bytes
symbols.description: Returns the loaded file contents of a cell.

symbols.name: load_count
symbols.description: Returns how many times the cell has completed loading.

symbols.name: take_new
symbols.description: Moves the list of newly loaded cells into the output array and clears the internal list.

symbols.name: finish
symbols.description: Marks a cell as fully loaded and updates counters and the new-cell queue.

symbols.name: update
symbols.description: Advances streaming for the player position, unloading far cells, receiving chunks and starting new loads.

symbols.name: resident_bytes
symbols.description: Returns the total bytes currently held by loaded cells.

modules.summary: The core of a scene editor: entities, undo and redo, parenting, save and load, picking and drag handles.

symbols.name: CUBE
symbols.signature: let CUBE = 0; let SPHERE = 1; let PLANE = 2; let LIGHT = 3
symbols.description: Constants identifying entity kinds (cube, sphere, plane, light) stored in an entity's kind field.

symbols.name: Ent
symbols.signature: struct Ent { id int, parent int, kind int, name byte[..64], t float3, r linalg::Quat, s float3, color float3 }
symbols.description: A scene entity with id, parent id, kind, name, translation, rotation, scale and color.

symbols.name: Op
symbols.signature: struct Op { kind int, at int, before Ent, after Ent }
symbols.description: A recorded edit holding the operation kind, entity index, and entity state before and after.

symbols.name: R3
symbols.signature: struct R3 { x real, y real, z real }
symbols.description: A three-component vector using real precision, used for ray and drag math.

symbols.name: Cam
symbols.signature: struct Cam { eye float3, target float3, up float3, fov_y f32, w f32, h f32 }
symbols.description: A camera description with eye, target, up vector, vertical field of view and viewport size.

symbols.name: E
symbols.description: Global list of all entities in the scene, in storage order.

symbols.name: NEXT
symbols.description: Next entity id to assign to a newly added entity.

symbols.name: OPS
symbols.signature: var OPS Op[>..] = []; var SA int[>..] = []; var SB int[>..] = []; var CUR = 0; var TX = 0; var DRAG = false
symbols.description: Global undo history state: operation log, step ranges, current step, transaction depth and drag flag.

symbols.name: reset
symbols.description: Clears all entities and undo history and resets id numbering to start over.

symbols.name: idx
symbols.description: Returns the storage index of the entity with the given id, or -1 if none exists.

symbols.name: ent
symbols.signature: ent(kind int, name const byte[:]) Ent
symbols.description: Creates a default entity of the given kind with the name truncated to 64 bytes, without adding it.

symbols.name: del
symbols.description: Removes the entity at the given storage index by shifting later entities down.

symbols.name: ins
symbols.description: Inserts an entity at the given storage index, shifting later entities up.

symbols.name: begin
symbols.description: Starts an undo transaction, discarding redo history, with nested calls grouped into one step.

symbols.name: commit
symbols.description: Ends an undo transaction and finalizes the step when the outermost one closes, dropping empty steps.

symbols.name: rec
symbols.signature: rec(kind int, at int, b Ent, a Ent)
symbols.description: Appends an operation record of the given kind, index, and before and after states to the log.

symbols.name: add
symbols.description: Adds an entity as an undoable step, assigning a new id if none is set, and returns its id.

symbols.name: set
symbols.description: Replaces the stored entity with the same id as an undoable step, ignoring unknown ids.

symbols.name: drag_begin
symbols.description: Begins a drag so that repeated entity updates merge into a single undo step.

symbols.name: drag_end
symbols.description: Ends a drag started earlier and commits its changes as one undo step.

symbols.name: under
symbols.description: Returns true if an entity is the given root or a descendant of it through parent links.

symbols.name: remove
symbols.description: Removes an entity and all its descendants as one undoable step, ignoring unknown ids.

symbols.name: undo
symbols.description: Reverts the most recent step, returning false if nothing can be undone or a transaction is open.

symbols.name: redo
symbols.description: Reapplies the most recently undone step, returning false if nothing can be redone or a transaction is open.

symbols.name: steps
symbols.description: Returns the number of steps currently applied in the undo history.

symbols.name: local
symbols.description: Returns the local transform matrix of the entity at the given storage index.

symbols.name: world
symbols.description: Returns the world transform matrix of an entity by id, combining parent transforms, or identity if unknown.

symbols.name: quat_of
symbols.description: Converts the rotation part of a matrix into a normalized quaternion.

symbols.name: reparent
symbols.description: Changes an entity's parent while preserving its world transform, returning false if the id is unknown or the move would create a cycle.

symbols.name: nums
symbols.description: Appends a list of numbers to a byte buffer as a JSON array.

symbols.name: save
symbols.description: Writes all entities into the buffer as JSON text, replacing its previous contents.

symbols.name: fl
symbols.signature: fl(d json::Doc&, n int, key const byte[:], k int) f32
symbols.description: Reads a float from an array member of a JSON node, defaulting when missing.

symbols.name: it
symbols.signature: it(d json::Doc&, n int, key const byte[:]) int
symbols.description: Reads an integer member of a JSON node, defaulting when missing.

symbols.name: load
symbols.description: Replaces the scene with entities parsed from JSON text, returning false if parsing fails or entities are missing.

symbols.name: r3
symbols.description: Converts a float3 vector to a real-precision R3 vector.

symbols.name: radd
symbols.description: Returns the component-wise sum of two R3 vectors.

symbols.name: rsub
symbols.description: Returns the component-wise difference of two R3 vectors.

symbols.name: rmul
symbols.description: Returns an R3 vector scaled by a real number.

symbols.name: rdot
symbols.description: Returns the dot product of two R3 vectors.

symbols.name: rcross
symbols.description: Returns the cross product of two R3 vectors.

symbols.name: runit
symbols.description: Returns an R3 vector scaled to unit length.

symbols.name: basis
symbols.description: Returns the camera's forward, right and up direction vectors.

symbols.name: ray
symbols.signature: ray(c Cam, px real, py real) R3, R3
symbols.description: Returns the ray origin and direction through a screen pixel for the camera.

symbols.name: project
symbols.signature: project(c Cam, p R3) real, real
symbols.description: Returns the screen pixel coordinates of a world-space point as seen by the camera.

symbols.name: xform
symbols.signature: xform(m gfx::mat4, p R3, w real) R3
symbols.description: Transforms an R3 point or direction by a matrix, using w to include translation or not.

symbols.name: hit
symbols.signature: hit(i int, o R3, d R3) real
symbols.description: Returns the ray distance to the entity at a storage index, or -1 if it misses.

symbols.name: pick
symbols.signature: pick(c Cam, px real, py real) int
symbols.description: Returns the id of the nearest entity under a screen pixel, or -1 if none is hit.

symbols.name: line_param
symbols.signature: line_param(o R3, d R3, p R3, a R3) real
symbols.description: Returns the parameter along an axis line closest to a ray, or 0 if they are parallel.

symbols.name: plane_point
symbols.signature: plane_point(o R3, d R3, p R3, n R3) R3
symbols.description: Returns the point where a ray meets a plane defined by a point and normal.

symbols.name: drag_axis
symbols.signature: drag_axis(c Cam, p R3, a R3, x0 real, y0 real, x1 real, y1 real) real
symbols.description: Returns how far a mouse drag moves along an axis, in world units along that axis.

symbols.name: drag_plane
symbols.signature: drag_plane(c Cam, p R3, n R3, x0 real, y0 real, x1 real, y1 real) R3
symbols.description: Returns the world-space offset of a mouse drag projected onto a plane.

symbols.name: drag_rotate
symbols.signature: drag_rotate(c Cam, p R3, a R3, x0 real, y0 real, x1 real, y1 real) real
symbols.description: Returns the angle in radians a mouse drag rotates about an axis through a point.

symbols.name: drag_scale
symbols.signature: drag_scale(c Cam, p R3, a R3, x0 real, y0 real, x1 real, y1 real) real
symbols.description: Returns the scale factor from a mouse drag along an axis, or 1 if the start is at the pivot.

symbols.name: snap
symbols.description: Rounds a value to the nearest multiple of the step, returning it unchanged if the step is not positive.

modules.summary: Connect an edited scene to the 3D renderer so it draws in the viewport.

symbols.name: KEYS
symbols.signature: var KEYS int[>..] = []; var ASSETS int[>..] = []
symbols.description: Parallel lists caching generated mesh asset handles and the appearance keys that identify them.

symbols.name: key
symbols.description: Returns an integer cache key combining an entity's kind and its RGB color quantized to 8 bits per channel.

symbols.name: asset
symbols.description: Returns the cached mesh asset for an entity's kind and color, creating a cube, sphere or plane when missing.

symbols.name: reset
symbols.description: Clears the mesh cache, scene items, lights and loaded glTF data so the viewport can be rebuilt from scratch.

symbols.name: camera
symbols.description: Sets the 3D renderer's view camera from an editor camera, using fixed near and far planes of 0.1 and 200.

symbols.name: sync
symbols.description: Rebuilds the renderer's items and lights from the edited scene, placing each entity at its world transform.

modules.summary: TCP and UDP sockets with addresses, polling, length-prefixed frames and readable error names.

symbols.name: AGAIN
symbols.description: Error code returned when a non-blocking operation has no data ready or cannot proceed yet; retry later.

symbols.name: INPROGRESS
symbols.description: Error code meaning a non-blocking connect has started but not yet finished.

symbols.name: INTR
symbols.description: Error code meaning the call was interrupted by a signal before completing.

symbols.name: BADF
symbols.description: Error code meaning the handle is not a valid open socket.

symbols.name: ACCES
symbols.description: Error code meaning permission to perform the socket operation was denied.

symbols.name: INVAL
symbols.description: Error code meaning an argument was invalid, such as a malformed address.

symbols.name: PIPE
symbols.description: Error code meaning the write failed because the connection's other end is closed.

symbols.name: NOSYS
symbols.description: Error code meaning the operation is not supported on this target.

symbols.name: MSGSIZE
symbols.description: Error code meaning the message is too large to send.

symbols.name: ADDRINUSE
symbols.description: Error code meaning the requested local address and port are already in use.

symbols.name: ADDRNOTAVAIL
symbols.description: Error code meaning the requested address is not available on this machine.

symbols.name: NETUNREACH
symbols.description: Error code meaning the network cannot be reached.

symbols.name: CONNABORTED
symbols.description: Error code meaning the connection was aborted before it could be accepted.

symbols.name: CONNRESET
symbols.description: Error code meaning the peer reset the connection.

symbols.name: NOTCONN
symbols.description: Error code meaning the socket is not connected.

symbols.name: TIMEDOUT
symbols.description: Error code meaning the operation timed out.

symbols.name: CONNREFUSED
symbols.description: Error code meaning the remote host actively refused the connection.

symbols.name: HOSTUNREACH
symbols.description: Error code meaning the remote host cannot be reached.

symbols.name: READ
symbols.description: Event flag requesting or reporting that the handle is readable.

symbols.name: WRITE
symbols.description: Event flag requesting or reporting that the handle is writable.

symbols.name: ERR
symbols.description: Event flag reported when the handle has an error condition.

symbols.name: HUP
symbols.description: Event flag reported when the peer has hung up.

symbols.name: ANY
symbols.description: Wildcard IPv4 address of zero, which binds to all local interfaces.

symbols.name: LOOPBACK
symbols.description: IPv4 address 127.0.0.1 as an integer, for connecting to the local machine.

symbols.name: Addr
symbols.signature: struct Addr { ip int, port int }
symbols.description: IPv4 address and port pair, with the address held as a 32-bit integer.

symbols.name: Poll
symbols.signature: struct Poll { n int, tags int[64], fds int[64] }
symbols.description: Fixed-capacity set of up to 64 handles with tags, used to wait for socket events.

symbols.name: KA
symbols.description: Scratch buffer holding the raw socket address structure passed to C calls.

symbols.name: KL
symbols.description: Scratch buffer holding the address length value passed to C calls.

symbols.name: KB
symbols.description: Shared scratch buffer used to stage received data before copying it out.

symbols.name: KP
symbols.description: Scratch buffer used for option values and poll structures in C calls.

symbols.name: err
symbols.description: Reads the C errno value and returns it negated, or -5 if it is zero.

symbols.name: ka
symbols.description: Fills the scratch address buffer with an IPv4 address and port.

symbols.name: kl
symbols.description: Resets the scratch address and length buffers to prepare for a C call that fills them.

symbols.name: kip
symbols.description: Returns the IPv4 address currently stored in the scratch address buffer.

symbols.name: kport
symbols.description: Returns the port currently stored in the scratch address buffer.

symbols.name: opt
symbols.signature: opt(fd int, lv int, o int, v int) int
symbols.description: Sets an integer socket option on a handle and returns the raw C result.

symbols.name: open_sock
symbols.description: Creates a non-blocking close-on-exec IPv4 socket of the given kind, returning a handle or negative error.

symbols.name: listen_raw
symbols.signature: listen_raw(ip int, port int, backlog int) int
symbols.description: Creates, binds and listens on a TCP socket for a raw IP and port, returning a handle or negative error.

symbols.name: accept
symbols.description: Accepts a pending connection on a listening handle, returning a new non-blocking handle or a negative error.

symbols.name: connect_raw
symbols.description: Starts a non-blocking TCP connection to a raw IP and port, returning a handle or negative error.

symbols.name: connected
symbols.description: Checks whether a non-blocking connect has finished, returning 0 on success, AGAIN if pending, or a negative error.

symbols.name: send
symbols.signature: send(h int, data const byte[:]) int
symbols.description: Sends bytes without blocking and returns the count sent, or a negative error code.

symbols.name: recv_into
symbols.description: Receives bytes into a caller buffer and returns the count, or a negative error code.

symbols.name: udp_raw
symbols.description: Creates a UDP socket bound to a raw IP and port, returning a handle or negative error.

symbols.name: send_to_raw
symbols.signature: send_to_raw(h int, ip int, port int, data const byte[:]) int
symbols.description: Sends a UDP datagram to a raw IP and port, returning the byte count or a negative error.

symbols.name: close
symbols.description: Closes a socket handle, returning 0 on success or a negative error code.

symbols.name: nodelay
symbols.description: Enables or disables TCP no-delay on a handle, returning 0 on success or a negative error.

symbols.name: blocking
symbols.description: Sets a handle to blocking mode when on is true, otherwise non-blocking, returning 0 or a negative error.

symbols.name: local_raw
symbols.description: Returns the local address of a handle packed into one integer, or a negative error.

symbols.name: peer_raw
symbols.description: Returns the peer address of a handle packed into one integer, or a negative error.

symbols.name: parse_ip
symbols.description: Parses a dotted IPv4 string or "localhost" into an integer, with false if the text is invalid.

symbols.name: addr
symbols.signature: addr(host const byte[:], port int) Addr
symbols.description: Builds an Addr from a host string and port, setting the IP to -1 if the host is invalid.

symbols.name: parse_addr
symbols.description: Parses text of the form host:port into an Addr, with false if malformed or the port is out of range.

symbols.name: format
symbols.description: Appends an address to the output buffer as dotted IPv4 text followed by a colon and port.

symbols.name: unpack
symbols.description: Converts a packed integer of address and port into an Addr.

symbols.name: valid
symbols.description: Returns whether an Addr has an IP within 32 bits and a port from 0 to 65535.

symbols.name: listen
symbols.description: Creates a TCP listening socket on an address, returning a handle or a negative error such as INVAL.

symbols.name: connect
symbols.description: Starts a non-blocking TCP connection to an address, returning a handle or a negative error such as INVAL.

symbols.name: recv
symbols.signature: recv(h int, out byte[>..]&, limit int = 65536) int
symbols.description: Appends received bytes to the output buffer, up to a limit, and returns the count or a negative error.

symbols.name: send_all
symbols.signature: send_all(h int, data const byte[:]) int
symbols.description: Sends all of the data, returning the total sent, or the count so far if it would block, or a negative error.

symbols.name: local_addr
symbols.description: Returns the local address of a handle, or an Addr with IP -1 and the error code as port on failure.

symbols.name: peer_addr
symbols.description: Returns the remote address of a connected handle, or an Addr with IP -1 and the error code as port on failure.

symbols.name: local_port
symbols.description: Returns the local port of a handle, or a negative error code.

symbols.name: udp
symbols.description: Creates a UDP socket bound to an address, returning a handle or a negative error such as INVAL.

symbols.name: send_to
symbols.signature: send_to(h int, to Addr, data const byte[:]) int
symbols.description: Sends a UDP datagram to an address, returning the byte count or a negative error such as INVAL.

symbols.name: recv_from
symbols.signature: recv_from(h int, out byte[>..]&, from Addr&) int
symbols.description: Receives a UDP datagram into the output buffer, stores the sender in from, and returns the byte count or a negative error.

symbols.name: clear
symbols.description: Empties a poll set so it holds no handles.

symbols.name: add
symbols.signature: add(p Poll&, h int, events int, tag int = 0) bool
symbols.description: Adds a handle with event flags and an optional tag to a poll set, returning false if it is full.

symbols.name: wait
symbols.description: Waits up to ms milliseconds for events, moves ready entries to the front, and returns their count or a negative error.

symbols.name: tag
symbols.description: Returns the tag stored for the poll entry at the given index.

symbols.name: handle
symbols.description: Returns the socket handle stored for the poll entry at the given index.

symbols.name: events
symbols.description: Returns the event flags reported for the poll entry at the given index after a wait.

symbols.name: wait_one
symbols.signature: wait_one(h int, events int, ms int) int
symbols.description: Waits up to ms milliseconds on one handle and returns its reported events, 0 on timeout, or a negative error.

symbols.name: frame
symbols.description: Appends a message to the buffer prefixed with its length as two little-endian bytes.

symbols.name: frame_len
symbols.description: Returns the total size of the first complete length-prefixed frame in the buffer, or 0 if incomplete.

symbols.name: error_name
symbols.description: Returns a readable name for a socket error code, or "socket error" if the code is unknown.

modules.summary: Minimal IPv4 UDP sockets.

symbols.name: SA
symbols.description: Scratch buffer holding the sockaddr structure passed to and filled by the C socket calls.

symbols.name: SL
symbols.description: Scratch buffer holding the address length value used by getsockname and recvfrom calls.

symbols.name: RB
symbols.description: Scratch buffer that receives raw incoming datagram bytes, sized to 2048 bytes per receive.

symbols.name: sa
symbols.description: Fills the scratch sockaddr buffer with an IPv4 address and port in network byte order.

symbols.name: ipv4
symbols.signature: ipv4(a int, b int, c int, d int) u32

modules.summary: Big-number and Montgomery arithmetic the other security modules build on.

symbols.signature: bn_from(b const byte[:], k int) u32[>..]

symbols.name: bn_bytes
symbols.signature: bn_bytes(a const u32[:], n int) byte[>..]
symbols.description: Converts limbs into a big-endian byte array of exactly n bytes, zero-padding or truncating high bytes.

symbols.name: bn_cmp
symbols.signature: bn_cmp(a const u32[:], b const u32[:]) int
symbols.description: Compares two limb numbers of possibly different lengths, returning -1, 0 or 1 for less, equal or greater.

symbols.name: bn_zero
symbols.description: Returns whether every limb is zero, scanning all limbs without early exit.

symbols.name: bn_bits
symbols.description: Returns the position of the highest set bit plus one, or 0 for zero.

symbols.name: bn_bit
symbols.signature: bn_bit(a const u32[:], i int) int
symbols.description: Returns bit i of the number as 0 or 1, where bit 0 is the least significant.

symbols.name: sub_mask
symbols.signature: sub_mask(a const u32[:], b const u32[:]) u32[>..], u32
symbols.description: Subtracts b from a limb by limb, returning the difference and an all-ones mask if it borrowed.

symbols.name: csel
symbols.signature: csel(m u32, a const u32[:], b const u32[:]) u32[>..]
symbols.description: Selects limbs of a when mask m is all ones or of b when zero, without branching.

symbols.name: cswap
symbols.signature: cswap(a u32[>..]&, b u32[>..]&, bit int)
symbols.description: Swaps the contents of two limb arrays when bit is 1, without branching on the secret bit.

symbols.name: mont_new
symbols.description: Builds a Montgomery context from big-endian modulus bytes, precomputing the word inverse, R squared and the Montgomery form of one.

symbols.name: mdbl
symbols.signature: mdbl(m const Mont&, a const u32[:]) u32[>..]
symbols.description: Doubles a value modulo the modulus, conditionally subtracting the modulus to keep the result reduced.

symbols.name: madd
symbols.signature: madd(m const Mont&, a const u32[:], b const u32[:]) u32[>..]
symbols.description: Returns the sum of two reduced values modulo the context's modulus.

symbols.name: msub
symbols.signature: msub(m const Mont&, a const u32[:], b const u32[:]) u32[>..]
symbols.description: Returns the difference of two reduced values modulo the context's modulus.

symbols.name: mmul
symbols.signature: mmul(m const Mont&, a const u32[:], b const u32[:]) u32[>..]
symbols.description: Returns the Montgomery product of two values, which is a*b/R modulo the modulus.

symbols.name: to_mont
symbols.signature: to_mont(m const Mont&, a const u32[:]) u32[>..]
symbols.description: Converts a value into Montgomery form by multiplying it with R squared.

symbols.name: from_mont
symbols.signature: from_mont(m const Mont&, a const u32[:]) u32[>..]
symbols.description: Converts a value out of Montgomery form back to an ordinary residue.

symbols.name: mpow
symbols.signature: mpow(m const Mont&, a const u32[:], e const u32[:]) u32[>..]
symbols.description: Raises a Montgomery-form base to an exponent given as limbs, returning the result in Montgomery form.

symbols.name: minv

symbols.name: reduce_once

symbols.description: Subtracts the modulus once from a value if it is not smaller than the modulus, without branching.

modules.summary: Fast GF(2^8) arithmetic over byte buffers and the AES S-box and MixColumns steps, using CPU vector instructions when present.

symbols.name: K
symbols.description: Cached CPU capability flag, negative until initialization detects whether vector instructions are available.

symbols.name: EXP
symbols.description: Lookup table of field element powers, doubled in length so log sums need no modular reduction.

symbols.name: LOG
symbols.description: Lookup table of discrete logarithms for nonzero field elements, used to multiply by addition.

symbols.name: SB
symbols.description: Lookup table holding the AES S-box substitution for each byte value.

symbols.name: ISB
symbols.description: Lookup table holding the inverse AES S-box substitution for each byte value.

symbols.name: init
symbols.description: Detects CPU vector support and fills the exponent, logarithm, S-box and inverse S-box tables.

symbols.name: mul
symbols.description: Returns the product of two field elements, initializing tables on first use.

symbols.name: dot64
symbols.signature: inline dot64(out byte[:], at int, vecs const byte[:], vat int, s const byte[:], sat int, rot int = 0, orot int = -1)
symbols.description: Computes one 64-byte block as the XOR of sixteen 64-byte vectors multiplied by repeated 4-byte groups, optionally rotating the stored result.

symbols.name: dot16
symbols.signature: inline dot16(out byte[:], vecs const byte[:], s const byte[:])
symbols.description: Computes sixteen 64-byte dot products at once over 1024-byte blocks, where each output row uses the matching row of s.

symbols.name: dot16
symbols.signature: inline dot16(out byte[:], vecs const byte[:], s const byte[:], perm const byte[:], rot const byte[:], mode int = 0)
symbols.description: Computes sixteen dot products over 1024-byte blocks with rows permuted and rotated by perm and rot, gathering in mode 0 and scattering otherwise.

symbols.name: dots
symbols.signature: dots(o byte[:], v const byte[:], g const byte[:], rot int, orot int)
symbols.description: Computes one 64-byte dot product with a portable fallback when vector instructions are absent, used by the inline dot functions.

symbols.name: mix
symbols.signature: mix(buf byte[:], at int, n int)
symbols.description: Applies the S-box then MixColumns to each 4-byte group of a buffer range.

symbols.name: mix_inv
symbols.signature: mix_inv(buf byte[:], at int, n int)
symbols.description: Applies InvMixColumns then the inverse S-box to each 4-byte group of a buffer range.

symbols.name: mixk
symbols.signature: inline mixk(buf byte[:], at int, n int, inv int)
symbols.description: Inline dispatcher choosing the vector routine or the scalar fallback for forward and inverse mixing.

symbols.name: mixs
symbols.signature: mixs(b byte[:], n int, inv int)
symbols.description: Scalar fallback that performs forward or inverse mixing on groups of four bytes, using vector code when possible.

symbols.description: Constant identifying the two-channel BC5 block format (16 bytes per block) for use with size, decode and encode.

symbols.name: BC7
symbols.description: Constant identifying the BC7 block format (16 bytes per block) for use with size, decode and encode.

symbols.name: P2
symbols.description: Lookup table of two-subset partition masks, one bit per pixel, for the 64 BC7 partitions.

symbols.name: P3
symbols.description: Lookup table of three-subset partition maps, two bits per pixel, for the 64 BC7 partitions.

symbols.name: A2
symbols.description: Table of anchor pixel indices for the second subset in two-subset BC7 partitions.

symbols.name: A3A
symbols.description: Table of anchor pixel indices for the second subset in three-subset BC7 partitions.

symbols.name: A3B
symbols.description: Table of anchor pixel indices for the third subset in three-subset BC7 partitions.

symbols.name: W2
symbols.description: Interpolation weight table for 2-bit BC7 indices, on a scale of 64.

symbols.name: W3
symbols.description: Interpolation weight table for 3-bit BC7 indices, on a scale of 64.

symbols.name: W4
symbols.description: Interpolation weight table for 4-bit BC7 indices, on a scale of 64.

symbols.name: M_SUBSETS
symbols.description: Number of subsets used by each of the eight BC7 modes.

symbols.name: M_PART
symbols.description: Number of partition selector bits for each of the eight BC7 modes.

symbols.name: M_CBITS
symbols.description: Color endpoint bit width per channel for each of the eight BC7 modes.

symbols.name: M_ABITS
symbols.description: Alpha endpoint bit width for each of the eight BC7 modes, zero when the mode has no alpha.

symbols.name: M_PBITS
symbols.description: Per-mode flag giving how the BC7 endpoint p-bits are stored: none, per endpoint, or per subset.

symbols.name: M_IBITS
symbols.description: Index bit width for each of the eight BC7 modes.

symbols.name: block_bytes
symbols.description: Returns the bytes per 4x4 block for a format code, or 0 if the format is unsupported.

symbols.name: size
symbols.signature: size(kind int, w int, h int) int
symbols.description: Returns the compressed byte size of a w by h pixel image in the given format, rounding up to whole blocks.

symbols.name: e5
symbols.description: Expands a 5-bit color value to 8 bits by bit replication.

symbols.name: e6
symbols.description: Expands a 6-bit color value to 8 bits by bit replication.

symbols.name: color_block
symbols.signature: color_block(b const byte[:], at int, four bool, px byte[:], o int)
symbols.description: Decodes one BC1-style color block into 16 RGBA pixels, treating it as four-color mode when requested.

symbols.name: alpha_palette
symbols.signature: alpha_palette(a0 int, a1 int, pal int[:])
symbols.description: Fills an 8-entry alpha palette from two endpoint values, using the BC3 and BC4 interpolation rules.

symbols.name: alpha_block
symbols.signature: alpha_block(b const byte[:], at int, px byte[:], o int, step int)
symbols.description: Decodes one BC3-style alpha block into a single channel of 16 pixels at the given offset and stride.

symbols.name: bits
symbols.signature: bits(b const byte[:], at int, pos int, n int) int
symbols.description: Reads n bits from a block starting at a bit position, least significant bit first.

symbols.name: bc7_anchor
symbols.signature: bc7_anchor(i int, ns int, part int) bool
symbols.description: Returns whether a pixel index is an anchor index for the given subset count and partition.

symbols.name: bc7_w
symbols.description: Returns the interpolation weight for index k at the given index bit width.

symbols.name: bc7_block
symbols.signature: bc7_block(b const byte[:], at int, px byte[:], o int)
symbols.description: Decodes one BC7 block into 16 RGBA pixels, writing transparent black for an invalid mode.

symbols.name: decode
symbols.signature: decode(kind int, blocks const byte[:], w int, h int, out byte[>..]&) bool
symbols.description: Decodes block-compressed data into RGBA pixels in out, returning false for an unsupported format, bad size or too little data.

symbols.name: fetch
symbols.signature: fetch(rgba const byte[:], w int, h int, bx int, by int, px byte[:])
symbols.description: Copies a 4x4 pixel tile from an RGBA image into a buffer, clamping coordinates at the image edges.

symbols.name: c565
symbols.signature: c565(r real, g real, bl real) int
symbols.description: Converts RGB values in the 0 to 255 range to a packed RGB565 color with rounding.

symbols.name: clamp255
symbols.description: Clamps a real value to the range 0 to 255.

symbols.name: pal4
symbols.signature: pal4(c0 int, c1 int, pal int[:])
symbols.description: Builds the four-color RGB palette for a BC1 block from two RGB565 endpoints.

symbols.name: assign4
symbols.signature: assign4(px const byte[:], pal const int[:], idx int[:]) int
symbols.description: Assigns each of 16 pixels to its nearest palette entry and returns the total squared error.

symbols.name: pack_color
symbols.signature: pack_color(px const byte[:], b byte[:], at int, four bool)
symbols.description: Encodes 16 RGBA pixels into a BC1-style color block using a principal axis fit with refinement.

symbols.name: pack_alpha
symbols.signature: pack_alpha(px const byte[:], o int, step int, b byte[:], at int)
symbols.description: Encodes one channel of 16 pixels into a BC3-style alpha block at the given offset.

symbols.name: bq_end
symbols.signature: bq_end(ef const real[:], at int, opaque bool, qf int[:]) int
symbols.description: Quantizes one BC7 endpoint to 7 bits plus the best p-bit, returning the chosen p-bit.

symbols.name: bq_make
symbols.signature: bq_make(ef const real[:], opaque bool, qf int[:], pb int[:], ev int[:])
symbols.description: Quantizes both endpoints of a BC7 block and computes their expanded values and p-bits.

symbols.name: bq_assign
symbols.signature: bq_assign(px const byte[:], ev const int[:], idx int[:]) int
symbols.description: Assigns 4-bit BC7 indices to 16 pixels and returns the total squared error.

symbols.name: bq_put
symbols.signature: bq_put(b byte[:], at int, pos int&, v int, n int)
symbols.description: Appends the low n bits of a value to a block at a running bit position.

symbols.name: pack_bc7
symbols.signature: pack_bc7(px const byte[:], b byte[:], at int)
symbols.description: Encodes 16 RGBA pixels into a BC7 mode 6 block using a principal axis fit with refinement.

symbols.name: encode
symbols.signature: encode(kind int, rgba const byte[:], w int, h int, out byte[>..]&) bool
symbols.description: Encodes RGBA pixels into block-compressed data in out, returning false for an unsupported format, bad size or too little data.

symbols.name: srgb_dec
symbols.description: Lookup table converting 8-bit sRGB values to linear floating point, filled on first use.

symbols.name: srgb_ok
symbols.description: Flag recording whether the sRGB decoding table has been filled.

symbols.name: halve
symbols.signature: halve(rgba const byte[:], w int, h int, srgb bool, out byte[>..]&) int, int
symbols.description: Downsamples an RGBA image to half size in out, optionally averaging in linear space for sRGB, and returns the new width and height.

modules.summary: Parses KTX2 texture files, validating headers and reading dimensions, color space, and mip levels for block-compressed or raw images.

symbols.name: Info
symbols.signature: struct Info { ok bool = false, kind int, srgb bool, width int, height int, levels int, scheme int, error int = 0 }
symbols.description: Describes the result of parsing a KTX2 file, including format kind, color space, dimensions, level count, supercompression scheme and error code.

symbols.name: E_NONE
symbols.description: Error code meaning the file parsed successfully with no error.

symbols.name: E_SHORT
symbols.description: Error code meaning the file is too short to hold the header or level index.

symbols.name: E_MAGIC
symbols.description: Error code meaning the file does not start with the KTX2 identifier bytes.

symbols.name: E_FORMAT
symbols.description: Error code meaning the file's Vulkan pixel format is not supported.

symbols.name: E_SHAPE
symbols.description: Error code meaning dimensions, depth, layers, faces or level count are unsupported or out of range.

symbols.name: E_SCHEME
symbols.description: Error code meaning the supercompression scheme is neither none nor zlib.

symbols.name: E_LEVEL
symbols.description: Error code meaning a mip level entry has an invalid offset, length or uncompressed size.

symbols.name: level_size
symbols.signature: level_size(kind int, w int, h int, n int) int
symbols.description: Returns the uncompressed byte size of mip level n for the given format kind and base dimensions.

symbols.name: is_ktx2
symbols.description: Returns whether the data begins with the 12-byte KTX2 file identifier.

symbols.name: rd32
symbols.signature: rd32(f const byte[:], at int) int
symbols.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit integer from the byte slice at the given offset.

symbols.name: rd64
symbols.signature: rd64(f const byte[:], at int) int
symbols.description: Reads a little-endian 64-bit integer at an offset, returning -1 if the value exceeds 31 high bits.

symbols.name: head_fail
symbols.description: Builds an Info result that carries only the given error code, with ok left false.

symbols.name: vk_kind
symbols.description: Maps a Vulkan format number to an internal block-compression kind, returning -1 when unsupported.

symbols.name: vk_srgb
symbols.description: Returns whether a Vulkan format number denotes an sRGB color encoding.

symbols.name: max_levels
symbols.description: Returns the number of mip levels in a full chain for an image of the given width and height.

symbols.name: head
symbols.description: Parses and validates a KTX2 header and level index, returning an Info whose ok is false on failure.

symbols.name: span
symbols.signature: span(file const byte[:], info Info, n int) int, int
symbols.description: Returns the byte offset and stored length of mip level n, or -1 and 0 when invalid.

symbols.name: read
symbols.description: Parses and validates a KTX2 file header and level index, returning an Info with ok false and an error code on failure.

symbols.name: adler32
symbols.description: Computes the Adler-32 checksum of the data, used to verify zlib-compressed levels.

symbols.name: unpack
symbols.signature: unpack(stored const byte[:], info Info, n int, out byte[>..]&) bool
symbols.description: Decodes one stored mip level into out, handling raw or zlib data, and returns false on any failure.

symbols.name: level
symbols.signature: level(file const byte[:], info Info, n int, out byte[>..]&) bool
symbols.description: Extracts mip level n into the output buffer, inflating zlib data and verifying it; returns false on failure.

symbols.name: put16
symbols.description: Appends a 16-bit value to the output buffer in little-endian order.

symbols.name: put32
symbols.description: Appends a 32-bit value to the output buffer in little-endian order.

symbols.name: put64
symbols.description: Appends a 64-bit value to the output buffer in little-endian order.

symbols.name: put_sample
symbols.signature: put_sample(out byte[>..]&, bit_off int, bits int, chan int, upper int)
symbols.description: Appends one sample descriptor entry for a data format descriptor to out, using the given bit offset, width, channel and upper bound.

symbols.name: sample_count
symbols.description: Returns the number of data format descriptor samples for a format kind, or 0 if unsupported.

symbols.name: put_dfd
symbols.signature: put_dfd(out byte[>..]&, kind int, srgb bool)
symbols.description: Appends the data format descriptor block for a format kind and color space to the output buffer.

symbols.name: write
symbols.signature: write(kind int, srgb bool, w int, h int, levels int, data const byte[:], deflate bool, out byte[>..]&) bool
symbols.description: Builds a KTX2 file from level data into the output buffer, optionally zlib-wrapped; returns false on invalid arguments.
